micb2b.com Revenue $1.8 Billion Marketech International Corp. (帆宣, TWSE: 6196), is a Taiwanese semiconductor facility engineering and equipment firm founded 27 December 1988 by Margaret Kao and Scott Lin, based at 6F, No. 3-2, Yuanqu Street, Nangang District, Taipei.
It runs four businesses: equipment and materials sales and service, automated gas and chemical supply systems, integrated MEP and cleanroom systems, and custom OEM/ODM equipment manufacturing.
2025 brought NT$51.57 billion of revenue, NT$3.17 billion of net income and record EPS of NT$15.50 on a 10.96 percent gross margin.
Nine months of 2026 already beat that year at NT$57.42 billion, up 55.5 percent, with EPS of NT$18.52 and October alone at NT$7.33 billion, up 77 percent.
Backlog was NT$135.1 billion in September 2026 and analysts see NT$157.8 to 165.7 billion by November, visibility to 2028; TSMC is 15 to 20 percent of sales, with 7 Taiwan plants, 33 subsidiaries, 2,269 staff and Foxconn ownership.

panlink.se PanLink AB is a Swedish contract manufacturer of cable harnesses, modules and complete assemblies, org.nr 556541-5295, Malmö, since April 1997.
It is wholly owned by the Fairford Holdings group, bought in 2006; the ultimate owner is the Osseiran family.
Production runs from Rokitki near Tczew, Poland (PanLink Sp. z o.o., KRS 0000355268), plus Bra, Italy; Sweden holds only the head office.
It serves rail and industry, with Alstom, ABB, Atlas Copco, Car-o-Liner, OXE Marine and Northvolt as customers and about 95 percent of sales exported.
Group revenue is roughly 354 to 362 million SEK with 340 to 370 staff, though the Swedish parent alone reports 11.2 million SEK and six employees.
The Polish plant lost 0.9 million PLN in 2023, 20.6 million in 2024 and 5.8 million in 2025 on 138.5 million PLN of sales, with 2.4 million PLN of equity against 98.9 million in assets.
Richard Alm became CEO in June 2026, replacing Lars-Gunnar Nilsson; ISO 9001, ISO 14001.

Medical liens 2021–2026 with patient and attorney names.
2023 audit + bank statements and check register.
Payroll and personnel files  SSNs, bank accounts.
Director's email archive  AHowell@fsems.org.pst.
Disciplinary cases and personal employee files.
City 911 board documents  RVCC, Motorola contract.
Appeal templates and insurance rates  BCBS, UHC, Medicare.

Its 2,500-seat showroom has hosted legends from Tony to Blake, while a 32-table poker room and a sportsbook sit beneath a 125,000-square-foot gaming floor. Sister properties bearing a yellow brick road and a lakeside house complete an empire that quietly funds scholarships and healthcare across the county.

Revenue=$303Billion / Stock Symbol=NVDA / https://www.zoominfo.com/c/nvidia-corp/136118787 / www.nvidia.com / NVIDIA, founded in 1993 and headquartered in Santa Clara, California, is a global technology company specializing in the design and manufacturing of graphics processing units (GPUs), computer hardware, and artificial intelligence computing solutions. The company develops advanced technologies for gaming, professional visualization, data centers, and automotive markets. NVIDIA's products and services power various applications, including high-performance computing, machine learning, autonomous vehicles, and cloud-based AI platforms.

aarp.org Revenue $10 Billion AARP is a Washington group founded in 1958 for 38 million Americans over 50, neither a charity nor an insurer. Its business is renting its name to UnitedHealthcare, The Hartford, New York Life and Avis and taking a cut of each sale. That cut brought 1.2 billion dollars in 2024, 62 percent of revenue, against just 289 million from 20-dollar dues. UnitedHealthcare then paid 9 billion upfront for 12 exclusive years, counted gradually rather than at once. It runs on 2,300 staff and 60,000 volunteers, 425 million in pay and about 194,000 per head. Another 21 million a year goes to lobbying Congress on Social Security, Medicare and drug prices, with no candidate endorsements. Critics call this a conflict with the biggest Medicare insurer; AARP says its commercial arm has no say in policy.

directvla.com Revenue $770.9 Million DIRECTV Latin America, operating under Vrio Corp. and owned by Argentine conglomerate Grupo Werthein since its 2021 buyout from AT&T, is a major satellite TV, streaming and telecom operator serving roughly 10 million subscribers across 11 South American and Caribbean markets. Generating about 771 million dollars in revenue in its regional corporate unit, it leads across Argentina, Colombia, Chile, Peru, Ecuador, Uruguay and the Caribbean through postpaid and cash-prepaid TV models. Beyond satellite broadcasting, it runs the DGO streaming platform, owns DSports holding premier FIFA World Cup and CONMEBOL football rights, and operates the 24/7 news channel DNews. Under Grupo Werthein it has expanded rapidly into fiber broadband via DFibra across five countries. In June 2024 it became Amazon Project Kuiper's exclusive satellite internet distributor in seven South American nations to rival Starlink, while bundling Max, Disney+ and Prime Video.

d124.org Evergreen Park Elementary School District 124 is a public school district in Evergreen Park, Illinois, a Chicago suburb, serving approximately 1,600 students from preschool through grade 8 across 7 schools. With 150 teachers and an 11 to 1 student-teacher ratio, it holds an 8 out of 10 GreatSchools rating with reading and math proficiency well above Illinois state averages. Led by Superintendent Dr. Robert Machak, the district operates 5 elementary schools, one middle school and an early childhood center. Its budget is approximately 25 to 30 million dollars per year with a Recognition-level financial rating from the Illinois State Board of Education. Programs include STEM, gifted education, special education, arts, athletics and 1:1 Chromebook technology integration. The district's motto is Learning Today, Leading Tomorrow, reflecting strong academic growth and community engagement.

vriocorp.com Vrio Corp is a Latin American telecommunications and media company spun off from AT&T in 2021, operating the DIRECTV and Sky satellite TV platforms across 10 countries with approximately 10 million subscribers and 4,000 plus employees. Headquartered in Miami with regional offices in Buenos Aires, São Paulo, Bogotá and Mexico City, it generates estimated revenue of 1.5 to 2 billion dollars annually. Its DIRECTV platform serves Argentina, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Uruguay and Venezuela while Sky operates in Brazil and Mexico. The company offers satellite TV packages, streaming through DIRECTV GO and Sky+ apps, cloud DVR and bundles with Disney+, HBO Max and Paramount+. Its sports portfolio includes ESPN, Fox Sports, Sky Sports and TyC Sports. As an independent entity it focuses on digital transformation, OTT growth and content partnerships across Latin America.

childbereavementuk.org Child Bereavement UK is a leading British charity founded in 1994 by Dr. Jenny Knight OBE, supporting families and educating professionals when a baby or child dies or is dying across the United Kingdom. With 80 to 120 staff and 200 to 300 volunteers, it serves over 5,000 families annually through individual counselling, group support, sibling programmes and a free helpline. It has trained over 20,000 professionals including NHS staff, teachers, social workers and emergency services in evidence-based bereavement care. Its services cover miscarriage, stillbirth, neonatal death, sudden infant death, childhood illness, suicide and parental bereavement. Revenue is approximately 5 to 8 million pounds from grants, donations, training income and fundraising events. The organization also conducts research and advocates for policy change in child bereavement care across England, Scotland and Wales.

southsoundoralsurgery.com South Sound Oral Surgery PLLC is an oral and maxillofacial surgery practice based in Lacey/Olympia, Washington State, with a second office in Tacoma, led by board-certified surgeons Dr. Ryan J. Irving and Dr. Andrew C. Chen. With approximately 15 to 25 employees and estimated revenue of 2 to 5 million dollars, it provides dental implants, wisdom teeth removal, bone grafting, orthognathic surgery, TMJ treatment and full-mouth rehabilitation. The practice is equipped with CBCT 3D imaging and CT-guided implant technology for precise surgical planning. It offers all levels of sedation from nitrous oxide to general anesthesia for patient comfort. It accepts most private insurance plans, Medicaid and TRICARE. Serving the South Sound region for over 15 years, it positions itself as the premier oral surgery center between Olympia and Tacoma.

ccbrt.org CCBRT (Comprehensive Community Based Rehabilitation in Tanzania) is the largest disability hospital in Tanzania, founded in 1994 in Dar es Salaam by the German organization CBM, with over 600 staff and more than 2 million patients served over 30 years. It provides ophthalmology including over 10,000 cataract surgeries, orthopedic rehabilitation, plastic surgery for burns and cleft lip, obstetric fistula repair and community-based disability programs across all 26 Tanzanian regions. Over 20,000 surgical procedures have been performed for people with disabilities including 3,000 fistula repairs and 5,000 clubfoot corrections using the Ponseti method. The organization combines a multi-specialty hospital in Dar es Salaam with mobile outreach teams reaching remote communities. Funding comes from CBM, international donors including USAID and the World Bank, the Tanzanian government and a social enterprise model. Its mission is preventing and treating disability in Tanzania through.

triangulo.com.br Triângulo Tecnologia E Comércio Ltda. is a Brazilian IT company founded in 1983 in Presidente Dutra, São Paulo, making it one of the oldest technology providers in Brazil with 43 years of market presence. With approximately 100 to 200 employees and estimated revenue of 20 to 50 million reais, it serves over 500 clients across small, medium and large businesses nationwide. Its core products include proprietary ERP systems, business intelligence dashboards, process automation and IT consulting services. The company offers full-cycle implementation from customization through integration to ongoing technical support. Key sectors include manufacturing, retail, logistics, healthcare and financial services across Brazil's interior markets. Its long track record and proprietary technology platform differentiate it from newer entrants in the Brazilian enterprise software market.

hicrete.com Hicrete Products & Technology Co., Ltd. is a Thai construction chemicals manufacturer founded around 2010 in Bangkok, producing epoxy and polyurethane floor coatings, waterproofing systems, concrete repair materials, anti-corrosion coatings and specialized building chemicals. With approximately 30 to 80 employees and estimated revenue of 5 to 20 million dollars, it serves industrial, construction, food, pharmaceutical, oil and marine sectors across Thailand and Southeast Asia. Its product range includes self-leveling epoxy floors, food-grade coatings, carbon fiber reinforcement, cementitious waterproofing and marine-grade anti-corrosion systems. The company operates its own manufacturing facility with in-house R&D for custom chemical formulations. It supplies contractors, architects and facility managers in countries including Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam and Myanmar. Its specialized portfolio addresses demanding environments from clean rooms and food processing.

boraxargentina.com Borax Argentina S.A.I.C. is an Argentine mining and chemical company founded in 1978, operating as a subsidiary of Rio Tinto and producing borate minerals and boric acid from mines in Salta and Jujuy provinces. With approximately 500 to 1,000 employees and estimated revenue of 150 to 300 million dollars, it runs the Tincalayu complex, Argentina's largest borate processing facility, and exports to over 30 countries. Its product range includes borax pentahydrate, boric acid, anhydrous borax and ulexite serving glass, ceramics, agriculture, detergents, metallurgy, pharmaceuticals and nuclear industries. The company is vertically integrated from mining through processing to global export via its own port facilities. As part of Rio Tinto Borates alongside the Boron mine in California, it is a key player in the global borate market. Growing demand from renewable energy, electric vehicles and micronutrient agriculture drives its strategic importance.

tismco.com Thompson Industrial Supply Company (TISMCO) is an American industrial MRO distributor founded in 1980 in Houston, Texas, with 46 years of experience serving the oil and gas, petrochemical, marine and power generation sectors along the Gulf Coast. With approximately 50 to 120 employees and estimated revenue of 25 to 75 million dollars, it supplies welding equipment, abrasives, power tools, electrical supplies, PPE, bearings, valves, pumps and fasteners. The company operates from its Houston Ship Channel headquarters with regional coverage across Texas, Louisiana and Oklahoma. Its product portfolio spans over 10,000 industrial SKUs from major brands including Bosch, DeWalt, SKF and Airgas. Family-owned since founding, it serves refineries, drilling operations, shipyards and construction firms across the Gulf Coast industrial corridor. It positions itself as a full-service industrial partner offering technical consulting alongside product supply.

behaviorinterventionservices.com Behavior Intervention Services LLC is a behavioral health company founded in 2008 in St. Louis, Missouri, providing ABA therapy, neuropsychological evaluation, mental health treatment and forensic assessment across Missouri, Kansas, Illinois and Iowa. With 200 to 500 employees including BCBAs, registered behavior technicians and neuropsychologists, it serves children and adults with autism, ADHD, learning disabilities and mental health conditions. Its services cover home-based and center-based ABA therapy, early intervention, social skills training, parent coaching and cognitive assessment. The company also provides court-ordered forensic evaluations including competency assessments and immigration evaluations. It accepts Medicaid, TRICARE and most private insurance plans. Revenue is estimated at 10 to 30 million dollars with over 10 office locations across the Midwest.

cykoria.pl Cykoria S.A. is a Polish food ingredients manufacturer founded in 1996 in Wąpielsk, specializing in instant chicory, dietary fibers including inulin and oligofructose, vegetable powders and custom food blends. With approximately 300 to 400 employees and revenue estimated at 20 to 40 million euro, it exports to over 40 countries across Europe, Asia, the US, Africa and the Middle East. The company processes chicory roots through its full production cycle from harvesting to extraction and spray drying at its facilities in Wąpielsk and Rypin. It holds ISO 22000, HACCP, BRC, IFS, Halal, Kosher and Organic certifications. Listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange NewConnect market, it is one of the largest chicory processors in Europe. Its products serve food and beverage, nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, bakery and animal feed industries globally.

groupe-serl.fr Revenue $150 Million Groupe SERL is a French engineering and construction group founded in 1985 in Rennes, Brittany, specializing in civil and industrial construction, MEP systems, facility management and energy solutions across France. With approximately 800 to 1,000 employees and estimated revenue of 120 to 150 million euro, it operates regional offices in Nantes, Paris, Lyon, Bordeaux, Lille and Toulouse. Its services span gross construction, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, fire protection, lift installation and renewable energy including solar and heat pumps. The group also provides full facility management including preventive and corrective maintenance, technical building management and energy optimization. It serves office, industrial, healthcare, education, retail, hotel and logistics sectors. Its motto is Build, Maintain, Innovate, reflecting a full lifecycle approach from construction through long-term operations.

livingwellhomecare.com Living Well Home Care is a home health agency founded in 2012 in Pearl City, Hawaii, providing skilled nursing, physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy and personal care services across all Hawaiian Islands. With approximately 100 to 200 employees including registered nurses, therapists and home health aides, it serves elderly and recovering patients who need hospital-level care at home. It is Medicare certified, Medicaid enrolled and TRICARE approved, accepting most major insurance plans. Its specialized programs cover post-surgical recovery, stroke rehabilitation, heart failure management, diabetes care and palliative support. Revenue is estimated at 5 to 15 million dollars with operations spanning Oahu, Maui, Big Island and Kauai. The company positions itself as a compassionate home care provider delivering clinical excellence in a comfortable home setting.

infflux.com Infflux is an international IT consulting and software development company specializing in digital transformation, custom software, cloud solutions, AI/ML and DevOps for enterprise clients. With approximately 50 to 150 employees and estimated revenue of 5 to 20 million dollars, it operates through a global delivery model spanning the US, Latin America and Europe. Its technology stack covers AWS, Azure, Java, Python, React, Kubernetes and TensorFlow. Services include custom development, data engineering, UI/UX design, QA automation and IT staff augmentation. It serves clients across finance, healthcare, retail and technology sectors. The company leverages nearshore delivery from Latin America with offices in Colombia, Mexico and Argentina for cost-effective engineering talent.

ebema.be Ebema NV is a Belgian family-owned concrete products manufacturer founded in 1946 in Zutendaal, celebrating 80 years in 2026 under third-generation CEO Jan Bijnens. With around 250 employees, 3 production plants and annual revenue of roughly 65 million euro, it operates through three brands: Stone&Style for private gardens, LivingCity for public urban spaces and CustomConcrete for bespoke architectural concrete. The company leads Belgium's transition toward climate-adaptive cities with water-permeable paving, grass-joint tiles and circular low-carbon concrete made from recycled aggregates. Following its acquisition of Marlux assets in 2021, it strengthened its market position across Belgium, the Netherlands and neighboring countries. Key projects include sponge-city public squares and custom urban furniture across Brussels, Antwerp and Ghent. It combines industrial scale with sustainability initiatives including solar-powered plants and electric logistics.

rosenberger.legal Rosenberger Legal is an Austrian law firm based in Salzburg, led by Dr. Stefan Rosenberger, a member of the Salzburg Bar Association. It provides legal services across civil law, commercial law, real estate, labor law, family law and criminal law. With a small team of 3 to 8 professionals, it serves individuals and businesses in the Salzburg region and across Austria. The firm handles contract disputes, corporate formation, property transactions, employment matters, divorce proceedings and criminal defense. It operates in German and English with a focus on personalized legal counsel. Its motto is Quality, Experience, Trust.

bioarch.com.tw BIOARCH is a Taiwanese bio-architecture company based in Taipei, specializing in eco-friendly building materials, natural coatings and green construction technologies. Founded around 2010, it operates at the intersection of biotechnology, architecture and sustainability. Its product range includes non-toxic bio-paints, antimicrobial coatings, natural insulation and decorative finishes for healthy indoor environments. The company serves residential, commercial and institutional projects across Taiwan. Key strengths are natural VOC-free formulations, antimicrobial properties and focus on healthy building certification standards. It positions itself as a leader in sustainable bio-building solutions for the Taiwan and Asia-Pacific market.

baexchange.mu ALL DATA BAE Exchange is a fintech platform based in Port Louis, Mauritius, providing cryptocurrency exchange and international money transfers through 400 plus physical agents across the island and a digital platform serving 32,000 plus clients. Founded by Flavia Moktof and Gungo Boucher, it operates across 7 countries including Mauritius, Seychelles, Maldives, Kenya, Tanzania, Madagascar and Reunion. Its hybrid online and offline model connects digital crypto trading with traditional remittance services targeting the Mauritian diaspora in France and India. Key services include BTC, ETH and USDT exchange for Mauritian rupees, competitive international transfer rates and insurance offerings. The company also runs financial education programs including webinars on cryptocurrency and regulatory frameworks in Mauritius. It positions itself as a trusted partner for underserved communities needing access to both modern crypto and traditional financial services.

eicoh.com EICOH Co., Ltd. (株式会社エイコー) is a Japanese IT and office solutions company founded in 1972 in Osaka by Yamada Goichi, now with dual headquarters in Osaka and Tokyo, 430 employees and annual revenue of 13.5 billion yen. Led by President Sakai Taihei since March 2024, it provides office equipment optimization, digital transformation, cybersecurity, paperless workflow and sales enablement services for major Japanese corporations. The company holds 25 government construction licenses covering civil engineering, telecommunications, electrical and building works. It operates subsidiaries in renewable energy (Eiko Energio with 2.2 MW solar capacity), media and regional services across Kinki, Kanto, Kyushu and Tohoku. Its history spans copier sales in the 1970s, fax boom in the 1980s, system integration in the 1990s and green energy since 2000. The company celebrated 50 years in 2024 and launched a new mission, vision and values under its new president.

vinsonprocess.com Revenue $296.3 Million Vinson Process Systems Company is an American process equipment and engineering firm founded in 1972 in Tulsa, Oklahoma, with over 54 years of experience serving the oil, gas, chemical and petrochemical industries. With approximately 300 to 500 employees across 10 offices in major US energy basins including Houston, Midland, Denver and Williston, it provides separation, heat transfer, compression, pumping and water treatment systems. The company partners with over 50 equipment manufacturers including Emerson, Ariel, Flowserve and Cameron to deliver turnkey process solutions. Its services span process engineering, equipment selection, skid-mounted system integration, commissioning and field service. Family-owned since its founding, it serves upstream, midstream and downstream sectors across North America with modular and custom-designed process packages.

prinsel.com.mx Productos Infantiles Selectos S.A. de C.V. (PRINSEL) is a Mexican children's products company founded in 1960 in Toluca de Lerdo, State of Mexico, with 66 years of experience manufacturing and distributing children's footwear, clothing and accessories. With approximately 200 to 500 employees, it serves the Mexican market through retail stores and distribution networks. Its product range covers shoes, clothing, baby items and school supplies for children from newborns to age 16. The company also operates in real estate and building management through subsidiary structures. Its motto is Quality and Trust for Your Children, reflecting decades of brand recognition among Mexican families. Based in the State of Mexico, it remains one of the oldest and most established children's product companies in the country.

solarium.com.br Solarium Revestimentos is a Brazilian manufacturer and distributor of ceramic tiles, porcelain, mosaics and decorative wall panels based in São Paulo with over 20 years of market presence. Its product range covers porcelain tiles in marble, concrete, wood and natural stone finishes from 30x30 to 120x260 centimeter formats for residential and commercial projects. With approximately 50 to 150 employees and estimated revenue of 20 to 50 million reais, it distributes through builders, retail chains like Leroy Merlin and its own showrooms across Brazil. The company operates its own manufacturing facility with in-house quality control and ABNT certification. Its portfolio includes decorative panels, geometric patterns, tropical designs and minimal collections alongside standard ceramic and porcelain. Key sectors are residential construction, commercial interiors and hospitality projects.

na.org.mk The National Agency for European Educational Programmes and Mobility is a government institution in Skopje, North Macedonia, established in 2006 to administer EU education and mobility programs including Erasmus+, Erasmus Mundus and the European Solidarity Corps. Over 20 years it has managed more than 2,500 projects involving 50,000 plus mobile participants and administering over 200 million euro in EU grants. Its activities cover higher education, vocational training, school education, youth and sport through Erasmus+ Key Actions 1, 2 and 3. The agency partners with over 1,000 organizations including universities, schools, NGOs and companies across 33 Erasmus+ countries. It also operates Eurodesk, eTwinning and Youthpass platforms for youth information and certification. Led by a director and board appointed by the Ministry of Education, it serves as North Macedonia's official Erasmus+ national coordinator.

bllcpas.com Burgess Lowman Lay CPAs is an American accounting firm based in Wilmington, North Carolina, with over 50 years of experience serving small and medium businesses, nonprofits and individuals. With approximately 20 to 30 professionals, it provides tax preparation and planning, bookkeeping, audits, reviews and business advisory services. Its client base includes manufacturing, real estate, healthcare, nonprofit organizations and high-net-worth individuals across southeastern North Carolina. Specialized offerings include employee benefit plan audits, single audits, IRS representation, business valuation and outsourced CFO services. The firm operates under the motto More Than Just Numbers, emphasizing strategic advisory beyond traditional compliance. Founded by its three named partners Burgess, Lowman and Lowman, it has built a deep reputation in the Wilmington business community.

alanmokengineering.com Alan Mok Engineering Pte Ltd is a Singapore-based mechanical and electrical engineering contractor founded in 2000, providing HVAC, plumbing, fire protection, electrical and low voltage systems for commercial, industrial, marine and institutional projects. With 100 to 200 employees and estimated revenue of 10 to 30 million Singapore dollars, it delivers full-cycle M&E services from design through commissioning and maintenance. Its specializations include chillers, ducting, sprinkler systems, electrical distribution, lightning protection and marine HVAC. The company holds BCA accreditation and bizSAFE certification with ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 standards. Projects span condominiums, office towers, factories, hospitals, schools and shipyards across Singapore. Led by founder Alan Mok, it has built a 26-year track record in Singapore's competitive M&E engineering market.

triad.co.ke Triad Group is a Kenyan digital marketing and technology company founded in 1993 in Nairobi, making it one of the oldest and largest digital agencies in East Africa with 200 plus employees and 500 plus clients. It operates across five divisions: digital marketing, creative and design, technology, strategy and media, with offices in Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda. Its client roster includes major multinational brands like Unilever, Coca-Cola, Safaricom, KCB and Toyota alongside government agencies and NGOs. Services span branding, video production, SEO, social media, software development, AI and machine learning, data analytics and media planning. The company positions itself at the intersection of creativity and technology with a full-service model from strategy to execution. Revenue is estimated in the multi-million dollar range with regional expansion across East Africa.

ninv.com National Investments Company (NIC) is one of Kuwait's leading investment firms, founded in 1987 and listed on Boursa Kuwait as NINV, managing 4.3 billion dollars in assets across four segments: investment, treasury, real estate and asset management. Led by CEO Fahad Abdul Al Mukhaizim, it employs 161 people across its Kuwait City headquarters and Dubai DIFC office. In 2026 it reported net profit of KWD 10.6 million for the first 9 months with AUM reaching KWD 1.4 billion and total return of 545 percent since 2019 versus 122 percent for the Kuwait index. It executed the Trolley General Trading IPO with 15.2x oversubscription and the Ali Alghanim Sons IPO, the largest in Kuwait in over a decade. Recognized by Euromoney as Best Investment Bank in Kuwait for Equity Capital Markets three consecutive years. Its strategy targets becoming a leading regional investment firm by 2029 through international expansion, alternative investments and strategic global partnerships.

municieneguilla.gob.pe Municipalidad Distrital de Cieneguilla is the local government of the Cieneguilla district in Lima Province, Peru, serving approximately 100,000 residents in a growing agricultural and tourism area along the Río Lurín. Led by Mayor Emilio Alberto Chávez Huaringa with 42 employees, it operates a digital services platform including virtual document submission, property tax queries, pet registration and sports facility booking. Key projects include the 2027–2029 Multi-Year Investment Plan, participatory budgeting and an inter-agency initiative to recover the Río Lurín ecosystem. The municipality promotes Cieneguilla as a natural refuge near Lima through a dedicated tourism portal showcasing local gastronomy, agriculture and outdoor activities. Transparency measures include a public accountability portal, public hearings and annual reporting to the Comptroller General. Staff grew by 162 percent as the municipality expanded digital and social inclusion programs.

gruposancristobal.com.mx Grupo San Cristóbal is a Mexican group of companies based in Mexico City, founded by Cristian Montalvo Flores, offering property management, accounting, construction, insurance and legal services across 10 plus business units. With over 250 employees, 500 clients and 2,800 properties under management, it provides full-cycle services for property owners and businesses. Its property management division handles condominium administration, maintenance, security, budgeting and owner meetings. Accounting services include bookkeeping, tax filings, payroll and audits for Mexican businesses. The construction arm delivers new builds, remodeling and preventive maintenance. The group's motto is Your Happiness Is Our Business, and it continues expanding its service portfolio across Mexico.

groupe-alternance.com Groupe Alternance is a French private education group founded in 2008 in Paris, offering work-study (alternance) programs across 5 schools with 10,000 plus students, 300 plus staff and 1,200 plus partner companies. Its model lets students earn a salary while their employer pays for their education, covering Bachelor, BTS and MBA programs in management, marketing, finance, HR, logistics, tourism and sport management. Key schools include ESAM, EFB, ECE, IPAC and the Institut de Management International, with campuses in Paris, Lyon, Marseille, Toulouse, Lille, Bordeaux and Strasbourg. Programs run through apprenticeship and professionalization contracts with companies covering tuition costs. Graduates receive state-recognized diplomas from Bac+2 to Bac+5. Its motto is that training should cost nothing and earn everything, positioning it as a new generation of business schools.

sielke.com Sielke is a German family company founded in 2002 in Hamburg, operating two brands: Sielke Papier for paper, packaging and office supplies, and Sielke Home for stylish home and living products. Headquartered at Dynamowerk 1 in Hamburg-Harburg, it has been serving businesses and consumers for 23 years. Sielke Papier provides a full range from printing and kraft paper to custom packaging solutions with sustainable FSC-certified options. Sielke Home offers decoration, kitchen, bath, wellness and gift products under the motto You Are Home. The company is estimated at 2 to 10 million euro in revenue with a small team of 20 to 50 employees.

imas.es I-Mas Informatica S.L. is a Spanish IT services company founded in 2002 in Sabadell, Barcelona, specializing in custom software development, cloud solutions, ERP implementation, cybersecurity and managed IT services. With 50 to 120 employees and estimated revenue of 3 to 8 million euro, it serves small and medium businesses, industrial companies and public sector clients across Catalonia and Spain. Its technology stack includes SAP, Odoo, Microsoft Dynamics, AWS, Azure, React, Java and Python. Services span web and mobile development, cloud migration, business intelligence, network management and VoIP telephony. The company positions itself as a full-service technology partner for businesses in the Vallès Occidental region and beyond. Its 24-year track record covers manufacturing, retail, healthcare, education and logistics sectors.

humboldt.ca City of Humboldt is a municipality in central Saskatchewan, Canada, founded in 1905 and named after scientist Alexander von Humboldt, with approximately 6,500 residents and a regional catchment of 30,000 people. It is the 13th city of Saskatchewan, located 117 km east of Saskatoon at the heart of the province's Iron Triangle agricultural and potash mining region. Its landmark project is a $40 million wastewater treatment facility completed in March 2026, funded $25 million by federal and provincial ICIP grants and $15 million by the city. Led by Mayor Rob Muench and outgoing City Manager Joe Day who retires in August 2026 after nearly a decade, the city employs 100 to 200 people across police, fire, water, recreation and public works. Major employers include Nutrien and BHP potash mines, Schulte Industries and Bourgault Industries agricultural manufacturers. The city runs a balanced water utility at 103 percent revenue coverage and has increased its debt limit to $20 mill.

resotechlaurentides.com Reso & Tech Laurentides is a Canadian industrial engineering company founded in 2001 in Saint-Jérôme, Quebec, specializing in the design and manufacture of specialized machinery, automation systems and robotic cells for automotive, aerospace, pharmaceutical and food industries. With approximately 150 employees and over 1,500 completed projects exported to more than 20 countries, it offers full-cycle services from concept design through manufacturing, commissioning and maintenance. Its capabilities span PLC and SCADA automation, industrial robotics, machine vision, test systems and custom assembly lines. The company operates from its main facility in Saint-Jérôme with commercial offices in Laval and Toronto. Revenue is estimated at 30 to 50 million dollars. Its automotive clients include major North American manufacturers while its aerospace and pharmaceutical projects demand precision engineering and sterile environments.

darrequipment.com Revenue $304.6 Mil Darreq Equipment is a specialty equipment rental company founded in 2010 in Denver, Colorado, with a second office in Bozeman, Montana, serving the Mountain West region including Colorado, Wyoming and Montana. With 50 to 100 employees and estimated revenue of 10 to 25 million dollars, it provides mobile generators, transformers, chillers, dehumidifiers, compressors, light towers and temporary infrastructure for construction, oil and gas, mining, healthcare and data center clients. It distinguishes itself from mass-market rental companies like United Rentals by focusing on specialized high-demand equipment for complex projects. The company operates its own delivery fleet with 24/7 emergency response capability. Key sectors include large-scale construction, energy projects, disaster recovery and data center cooling. Its niche approach avoids direct competition with national rental giants while serving demanding industrial clients in the Mountain West.

megatrans.com.ar Megatrans S.A. is an Argentine road freight and logistics company founded in 1991 in Lanús, Buenos Aires, with 35 years of experience in general, heavy and dangerous goods transportation across Argentina and Mercosur. With over 200 employees and a fleet of 150 plus trucks, it operates regional terminals in Rosario, Córdoba, Neuquén and Mendoza with GPS-tracked vehicles. Its specialized services include ADR-certified dangerous goods transport for chemical, pharmaceutical and oil and gas industries alongside food and automotive logistics. The company holds CNRT and RUTA Seguro 837 certifications and provides full-cycle logistics including warehousing, customs clearance and insurance. International routes cover Brazil, Chile, Uruguay, Paraguay and Bolivia. Major clients include YPF, BASF, Arcor, Toyota Argentina, Carrefour and Techint.

unitedpharmacy.sa United Pharmaceuticals Company is Saudi Arabia's third largest pharmacy chain, founded in 1990 in Jeddah by Sheikh Dr. Mohammed Al Yassin, with 450 plus branches across 80 cities and over 1,100 employees in 8 countries. It holds a 10 percent market share and targets 15 percent by 2027 through aggressive expansion, including the SAR 100 million acquisition of Kunooz Pharmacies in February 2026 and plans to open 100 new branches this year. Led by CEO Khalid Yassin since January 2024, it was awarded Great Place to Work in Saudi Arabia in 2024 and 2025. Its mobile app has 656K installs with a 4.71 star rating and offers cash on delivery, Tamara installment plans and insurance prescription dispensing. Strategic MoUs with Sudair Pharma and PPI Company aim to expand access to innovative medicines. The company competes with Nahdi (1,207 stores) and Al Dawaa (954 stores) but grows fastest among the top three.

clancysystems.com Clancy Systems International is an American parking technology company founded in 1978 in Englewood, Colorado, with over 10,000 parking systems installed in more than 500 cities across the United States and Canada. With approximately 130 employees and estimated revenue of 25 to 50 million dollars, it provides pay stations, parking software, license plate recognition and smart city solutions. Its ParkEngine cloud platform handles real-time parking management, enforcement, permits and revenue analytics. The company offers solar-powered stations, ADA-compliant units and EV charging integration alongside mobile payment options. It is one of the oldest and largest parking technology providers in North America with 48 years of continuous operation. Services span installation, maintenance, 24/7 support and consulting for municipal and private parking operators.

orennia.com Orennia is a Canadian energy intelligence platform founded in 2021 in Calgary, providing data analytics for solar, wind, battery storage, hydrogen, carbon capture, transmission and crypto mining sectors. With 116 employees and 1,000 plus platform users, it has raised 35 million dollars from General Catalyst and other investors, generating estimated revenue of 18.7 million dollars with 30 percent annual growth. Led by founder and CEO Brooke Coleman, its platform combines project databases, market intelligence, interconnection queue tracking and AI-powered predictive analytics. Clients include utilities, renewable developers, private equity, hedge funds and banks across North America. Its unique Interconnection Queue Tracker covers every major grid operator in the US and Canada. The company is based in Calgary with a second office in Toronto and competes with Enverus, Wood Mackenzie and Bloomberg NEF.

esri-southafrica.com sri South Africa is the exclusive distributor of Esri's ArcGIS geospatial platform in southern Africa, founded in 1989 in Midrand with 206 employees across 5 offices and over 2,000 clients. Led by Managing Director Patrick McKivergan, it serves government, utilities, mining and banking sectors with major projects like the City of Cape Town CityMap Viewer and ESKOM asset management. Its Esri South Africa College offers an NQF Level 6 Diploma in GISc&T and is the only Esri accredited learning center in the region. The company holds B-BBEE Level 1 status and runs free GIS training for unemployed youth. It participates in the Map Africa Initiative with Microsoft and Space42 to map all 54 African countries. Revenue is estimated at 23.2 million dollars with government contracts including a R34 million deal with DFFE.

mkg-kirchrode.de 900GB MKG Kirchrode is a premium oral and maxillofacial surgery practice in Hannover-Kirchrode, Germany, led by Dr. med. Jennifer Rublack with Dr. Dr. Holger Moysich and Dr. Stephan Adam. Its 420 square meter facility offers the full spectrum of MKG surgery from wisdom teeth removal and dental implants to skin cancer reconstruction and aesthetic procedures like thread lifting and Botox. Three levels of anesthesia including general anesthesia and sedation are available for anxious patients, with a dedicated anesthesiologist on staff. The practice is equipped with an operating microscope, 3D CBCT imaging, soft laser and PRP therapy, offering both titanium and ceramic implants. Open Monday to Friday from 7:45 to 18:00, it provides barrier-free access, free parking and is just 1 minute from the U6 U-Bahn station. Services are available in German, English, Italian, French and Polish with interest-free installment payment plans.

customssupport.com Revenue $389.4 Million IZD GmbH Europe's largest customs brokerage network, founded with headquarters in the Netherlands and operating 50 plus offices across 14 countries with over 1,600 employees. Its German subsidiary IZD GmbH is based in Duisburg, Europe's largest inland port, providing 24/7 customs clearance for automotive, electronics, pharmaceutical and e-commerce clients. Services cover import and export clearance, transit procedures, tariff classification, bonded warehousing, AEO certification and export controls. The group is backed by European private equity fund Castik Capital and serves over 5,000 clients. Its digital platform at customssupport.com offers EDI integration, real-time tracking and customs data analytics. Estimated group revenue is 300 to 500 million euro with recent additions including Brexit advisory and preferential trade consulting.

itsubishi-motors.com.ua Mitsubishi Motors Ukraine is the official importer and distributor of Mitsubishi Motors vehicles in Ukraine, managing sales, service and parts through over 20 authorized dealers nationwide. Its model range includes the Outlander and Outlander PHEV crossover, Eclipse Cross, ASX and the legendary L200 pickup truck. As part of the Renault-Nissan-Mitsubishi Alliance, it benefits from global R&D, shared platforms and a 5-year warranty. The Ukrainian automotive market recovered to around 60,000 new car sales in 2025, with Mitsubishi holding a 3 to 5 percent share led by Outlander and L200. Services span new and certified pre-owned sales, original parts, financing through partner banks and full after-sales support. Strategic initiatives include expanding the PHEV hybrid lineup and preparing for fully electric model launches.

european-motorcars.com European Motorcars is a multi-brand premium European car dealership founded in 1972 in Dayton, Ohio, with 54 years of experience selling and servicing Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Audi, Porsche, Land Rover, Jaguar, Volvo and MINI. With 50 to 100 employees across two locations on Miamisburg-Centerville Road and Dorothy Lane in Kettering, it offers new and certified pre-owned vehicles, official service centers with brand-specific diagnostic equipment and an in-house body shop. The dealership provides full-cycle services including financing, insurance, trade-in and professional detailing. It stands out as one of the few multi-brand premium European dealers in the region, allowing customers to compare and service multiple brands under one roof. Key strengths are 54 years of local trust, certified technician teams for each brand and original parts inventory. It serves the greater Dayton metropolitan area of approximately 800,000 people.

megchem.com MegChem is a South African engineering consultancy founded in 1985 in Secunda, Mpumalanga, providing process, mechanical, structural, electrical and piping engineering for the petrochemical, oil and gas, energy and mining sectors. With over 350 engineers and offices in Secunda, Cape Town, Johannesburg and Richards Bay, it offers full lifecycle services from FEED studies through detailed design to construction supervision. It is strategically located next to Sasol Secunda, one of the world's largest petrochemical complexes, giving it direct access to major projects. Key sectors include coal-to-liquids, gas processing, refinery upgrades, power generation and water treatment. The company has completed projects across South Africa and Mozambique over 41 years of continuous operation. Its 8 engineering disciplines under one roof enable integrated multidisciplinary delivery for large-scale industrial projects.

translogwest.de TransLogWest S.L. is a Spanish freight forwarding and logistics company founded in 2012 in Bilbao, Basque Country, specializing in international maritime, air, road and rail transport with customs clearance services. With around 20 employees and offices in Galdakao (Bizkaia) and Madrid, it positions itself as a boutique logistics partner for mid-sized businesses. The company holds AEO, IATA and FIATA certifications enabling streamlined customs processing and multimodal transport worldwide. Its services cover FCL and LCL container shipping, air freight, project cargo, dangerous goods, warehousing and temperature-controlled logistics. Key strengths are personalized service, full multimodal capability and European customs expertise. It serves clients across Europe, Asia, Latin America and North Africa.

neighborhoodhouse.org Revenue $238.7 Million Neighborhood House is Portland's oldest nonprofit social services organization, founded in 1905 and serving over 3,000 people annually through food, education, health and housing programs. With 50 to 100 staff and hundreds of volunteers, it operates from a modern campus in the Marquam Hill and South Waterfront area of Southwest Portland. Its programs include a food pantry, Head Start early childhood education, ESL classes, mental health services, senior programs and emergency rental and utility assistance. The organization holds a 3-star Charity Navigator rating and is part of the National Community Action Partnership. In 2018 it completed a major campus expansion and in 2025 celebrated 120 years of continuous community service. It is funded through federal and state grants, foundation support including the Oregon Community Foundation and United Way, corporate sponsorships and individual donations.

airdriechristian.com Airdrie Christian Academy is a private K-12 Christian school founded in 1987 in Airdrie, Alberta, with over 1,250 students across full-time, shared responsibility and home education programs. Accredited by Alberta Education and ranked 60th out of 292 high schools by the Fraser Institute, it is the top-ranked school in Airdrie. Led by Head of School Andrew Casali, it offers 40 plus elective courses from robotics and 3D printing to woodworking and criminal science alongside Bible instruction and worship teams. The school represents 45 plus nationalities through its International Student Program and annual multicultural weeks. Tuition ranges from 4,085 to 9,345 Canadian dollars per year with the fourth child attending free and charitable donation receipts reducing tax costs. Its athletes compete at provincial zone levels and graduates pursue university, trades, professional sports and international missions.

ashrosary.org Academy of the Sacred Heart is a private Catholic all-girls school in New Orleans founded in 1867, educating girls from age 1 through grade 12 across two campuses on historic St. Charles Avenue. Ranked the number one Catholic, all-girls and K-12 school in Louisiana by Niche, it enrolls 818 students with a 9 to 1 student-faculty ratio and 18 AP courses. It is part of a global network of 150 plus Sacred Heart schools in 41 countries, sending 77 students on international exchanges in 2025-26 to places like Austria and Uganda. Its Cardinals athletics program has won 111 state titles since 1984, including the 2026 Division II state golf championship. Tuition ranges from 17,530 to 24,800 dollars per year with financial aid available. The school's Innovation Lab features design thinking, 3D printing and robotics, and 100 percent of graduates are accepted to four-year colleges.

hightec.ch HighTec AG is a Swiss industrial engineering company founded in 1988 in Winterthur, specializing in turnkey surface treatment systems including painting booths, powder coating lines, air filtration and drying systems. With 50 to 100 employees, it designs, manufactures, installs and maintains coating solutions for automotive, aerospace, furniture and metal fabrication industries. Its product range covers dry filter and water wash booths, cartridge filter systems, ATEX explosion-proof solutions, electrostatic coating and energy-efficient drying ovens. The company emphasizes Swiss quality engineering with VOC compliance, waste heat recovery and digital monitoring. Key strengths are 38 years of experience, full turnkey delivery from concept to commissioning and ATEX-certified hazardous environment systems. It competes with Dürr and Nordson while offering personalized Swiss engineering and local European support.

pages.com.ve Pages Asociados C.A. is a Venezuelan engineering and consulting firm founded in 1972 in Caracas with over 52 years of experience in civil, structural, mechanical and electrical engineering. It operates its own geotechnical and materials testing laboratory, covering soil mechanics, concrete, asphalt and steel testing alongside field investigation services. With offices in Caracas, Maracaibo, Puerto Ordaz and Barinas, it serves the oil and gas, transport, energy and industrial sectors across Venezuela. Key projects include oil terminals for PDVSA, highways, bridges, hydropower plants and port infrastructure. Led by the Pages family across multiple generations, it employs around 200 to 500 engineers and technicians depending on project load. Key strengths are 52 years of market presence, in-house laboratory capabilities and full-service engineering from design through construction supervision and project management.

saude.mt.gov.br The Secretaria de Estado de Saúde de Mato Grosso is the state health department of Mato Grosso, Brazil, responsible for public healthcare across 141 municipalities and 3.6 million inhabitants. Headquartered in Cuiabá under Secretary Renata Aparecida Barbirato, it manages state hospitals, laboratories, blood centers and the AFFARMES free medication program. Its network includes the Julio Müller General Hospital, the Tropical Diseases Hospital, the Maternal-Infant Hospital, UPA emergency units and the LACEN state laboratory. In 2026 it launched new water quality monitoring programs and updated its vaccination calendar including COVID-19 and tropical disease campaigns. The department runs an open procurement portal for medical equipment and pharmaceuticals with a budget of approximately 4 to 5 billion reais. Digital transformation initiatives include electronic health records, the SEI-MT document system and integration with Brazil's national health data network.

fivestarplating.com Five Star Plating LLC is an American electroplating and metal finishing company founded in 2007 in Little Rock, Arkansas, with 82 employees and approximately 12.5 million dollars in annual revenue. It operates 3 automatic plating lines plus 1 manual rack line across two facilities, coating around 50 million parts per year. Its core offerings include zinc and zinc alloy plating, phosphate coatings, E-Coat electrocoating and specialty finishes like zinc-nickel as a cadmium replacement for aerospace and defense. The company serves automotive, oil and gas, construction, aerospace and military clients with ISO 9001 certification and salt spray testing capabilities up to 1,000 hours. Key strengths are full-spectrum plating from mass barrel to custom rack work, a dedicated testing laboratory and strategic location in central Arkansas. It is the largest specialized plater in the state with continued growth of 16 percent year over year.

bsfgroup.co.uk Barkingshopfronts Limited is a London-based shop front manufacturer and installer founded in 2018 in Barking, specializing in aluminium, frameless glass and timber shop fronts, roller shutters, canopies and structural steel for retail, restaurants and offices. With around 20 to 30 staff and estimated revenue of 1 to 5 million pounds, it runs its own production facility on Movers Lane in East London. Its unique Sit-and-Go Shops product offers fully fitted ready-to-open retail spaces from frontage to interior fixtures. The company has delivered projects across all London boroughs including a flagship aluminium frontage for a Mayfair espresso bar and international work in Romania. Services span design, manufacturing, installation and maintenance of shop fronts, bi-fold doors, automatic doors, fire exits and security shutters. Key strengths are in-house production, full-spectrum frontage solutions and the innovative turnkey shop concept.

antwerphousedentistry.co.uk Antwerp House Dental Practice is a premium private dental clinic in Cambridge, England, founded in 2011 by Dr. Daniel Hayes and located in a 600-year-old historic building on Lensfield Road near Cambridge University. With 10 to 20 staff and a 4.9 out of 5 rating across 500 plus Google reviews, it offers dental implants, Invisalign, cosmetic dentistry, microscope-assisted endodontics and CEREC same-day crowns. Dr. Hayes holds an Advanced Diploma in Implantology and FICOI Fellowship status, and the practice is a Diamond Invisalign Provider. It also operates as a referral center for complex root canal cases from other Cambridge dentists. Technologies include CBCT 3D scanning, digital smile design, intraoral scanning and diode laser treatment. The team of specialists covering implants, orthodontics, endodontics and hygiene all work under one roof with payment plans available for nervous patients.

logsytech.fr Logsytech Group is a French logistics holding company based in Émerainville near Paris, founded in 2001 and acquired by D-Groupe Logistique in December 2022. With 160 employees, 7 warehouses totaling 30,000 square meters and 4 million shipments per year, it provides e-commerce, telecom, IoT and marketing logistics services. Its six subsidiaries cover Optilog for e-commerce, Mecalog for telecom equipment, ARC for point-of-sale advertising logistics, Optiaustral for Reunion Island distribution and Logsys for in-house IT solutions. Major clients include SFR, TotalEnergies, Weight Watchers, La Française des Jeux and Recommerce. The group runs its own WMS, ERP and TMS software with real-time tracking and a call center handling 3,000 calls per day. Combined with D-Groupe, the entity generates 100 million euro in revenue with 600 staff.

lightingdirect.co.nz Lighting Direct is New Zealand's largest lighting specialist, founded in 1974 in Auckland by Bill and Penny Fulford as Keldene Industries and rebranded in 1992, now operating 23 stores nationwide plus an online store. Led by CEO Dean Fulford, the second generation of the family, it buys directly from overseas manufacturers, landing one container of lighting daily to its Auckland distribution center. Its range covers pendant lights, ceiling lights, wall lights, downlights, outdoor lighting, lamps and ceiling fans across modern, Scandinavian and classic styles. The company was the first retailer to reopen after the 2011 Christchurch earthquake and celebrated 50 years in business in 2024. In 2025 it opened a new Queenstown store and launched a redesigned online platform. Free design consultations, a trade programme for builders and electricians, free shipping over 200 dollars and 7-day returns make it the go-to lighting destination for Kiwi renovators.

redblink.com RedBlink Technologies is an AI and software development company founded in 2008 in Danville, California, with over 150 employees across a hybrid onshore/offshore model spanning the US, India, Canada, Italy and Dubai. It specializes in generative AI, machine learning, NLP, AI chatbots, web and mobile development, cloud, DevOps and AI-powered SEO services. Led by Director of Delivery Sahil Aggarwal and Director Bahadur Singh, it serves healthcare, retail and technology clients from startups to enterprises. Revenue is estimated at 10 to 25 million dollars with competitive rates around 15 dollars per hour thanks to its India-based development center in SAS Nagar. Its tech stack includes Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, React, Node.js, AWS and fine-tuned LLM models like BERT and GPT. The company is self-funded with no external investors and offers rapid staff augmentation including ChatGPT developers within 48 hours.

coemi.com.br Coemi Imóveis is a Brazilian real estate agency founded in 1985 in Brasília with 41 years of experience in buying, selling, renting and property management across the Federal District and Goiás state. It operates three offices including its Asa Norte headquarters, an Águas Claras branch and a new Goiânia unit opened in 2023, with 18 to 33 employees and a portfolio of over 1,500 rental properties. The company is an official correspondent of Caixa Econômica Federal for mortgage financing and a member of the Rede Brasília de Imóveis network. Its services cover personalized sales consulting, rental management with differentiated payment options, property evaluation and legal support through to notarial closing. It runs a free online property valuation tool and actively publishes market guides for Brasília neighborhoods. Led by a single owner and registered under Simples Nacional as a small enterprise with R$78,800 in share capital.

labatecpharma.com Revenue $19 Million Labatec S.A. is a Swiss laboratory instruments company founded in 1965 in Meyrin, Geneva, manufacturing and distributing high-precision analytical equipment for chemistry, biotech, pharma and energy sectors across 100 plus countries. Its three divisions cover Labatec Instruments for analytical and sample preparation equipment, Labatec Pharma for GMP quality control solutions and Labatec Energy for oil and gas testing systems. With offices in Geneva, Zurich and Dubai Jebel Ali Free Zone, it partners with major global brands including Metrohm, Anton Paar, Mettler Toledo, Agilent and Thermo Fisher. The company holds ISO 9001, ISO 17025 calibration and ISO 13485 medical device certifications. Its product range spans titrators, spectrometers, chromatographs, pH meters, mills, centrifuges and industrial fuel analyzers. It serves customers from small labs to multinational pharmaceutical and petrochemical corporations.

kabs.com Revenue $27.2 Million KABS Laboratories is a Canadian pharmaceutical CDMO founded in 1997 in Saint-Hubert, Quebec by Dr. Jean-Simon Blais and Dr. Gérard Akinocho, with 150+ specialists serving clients in 28 countries. It is a WHO prequalified Quality Control Laboratory audited by Health Canada, USFDA and EU QPs, offering aseptic manufacturing from 100 to 100,000 vials per batch. In 2021 it received CAD 54.2 million from Canada's Strategic Innovation Fund to expand fill-and-finish to 30 million vials per year and build a bioprocessing plant for monoclonal antibodies. Through joint venture MendeliKABS it developed MDK-Nitisinone, an orphan drug for tyrosinemia type 1, priced 10 times lower than the Swedish competitor and approved in Europe, UK, Brazil, China and Algeria. The company also runs an African quality control office in Benin.

solutis.com.br Revenue $53 Million Solutis Tecnologias is a Brazilian IT integration company founded in 2010, now headquartered in São Paulo with over 1,200 employees across 5 countries. It specializes in AI, digital transformation, Salesforce, FICO and cloud solutions for financial services, utilities and public sector clients like Sabesp, Furnas, Serasa and Banco Rendimento. In September 2026 it launched SOL.AI, a proprietary AI platform with 6 solution domains covering agentic software engineering, data pipelines, enterprise AI governance and regulatory readiness. Led by CEO Paulo Marcelo since 2019, revenue grew from R$100 million to R$140 million in 2022 with a target of R$300 million by 2027. Strategic partnerships include Salesforce, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks and Elastic. Its own AI Center and Studio.AI development platform power client delivery.

grupolorrio.es Grupo Lorrio is a Spanish industrial engineering and construction group founded in 1989 in San Fernando de Henares, Madrid, formerly known as J Lorrio SL and rebranded in 2020. Led by sole owner and administrator Raúl Lorrio González, the group comprises J. Lorrio, Lorclima and Grupo 6, offering full lifecycle services from engineering design to installation and maintenance of industrial systems. Its 14 technical specialties include fire protection, HVAC, refrigeration, compressed air, steam, plumbing, electrical, insulation and intelligent building management. The company holds triple ISO certification covering quality, environmental management and occupational health and safety. With 4 to 10 employees and revenue up to 1.5 million euro, it serves industrial clients across the Madrid region with a no-exclusivity policy that ensures best-fit solutions. Its integrated model covers project, construction, maintenance and energy management phases in one continuous service.

mcewanfraserlegal.co.uk McEwan Fraser Legal is Scotland's largest property law firm and award-winning estate agency, founded in 2009 in Edinburgh by Ken McEwan and former footballer Scott Fraser, with 100 to 160 staff across 20 plus locations in Scotland. It was the first Scottish firm to win the Sunday Times Best Estate Agency in the UK award in 2013 and has since collected over 20 national awards including multiple Negotiator Awards and Scottish Legal Awards. Its unique model combines solicitors, estate agency and marketing under one roof with a proprietary Property Matching database and PRO tracking system. The firm operates 7 days a week until midnight, employs translators in 12 languages for overseas investors and runs 5,000 plus targeted landing pages. Revenue is estimated at 16 to 19 million dollars annually. CEO Ken McEwan has been nominated for Entrepreneur of the Year at the 2026 British Business Awards.

hausarzt-praxis-ries.de Hausarztpraxis Ries is a family general practice in Frickenhausen, Baden-Württemberg, Germany, run by three doctors from the Ries family offering comprehensive primary care for patients aged 14 and above. Its services span acute and chronic disease treatment, minor surgery, pain therapy, palliative care, geriatric medicine and acupuncture. The practice is equipped with ECG, Holter monitoring, ultrasound, spirometry and an in-house lab plus disease management programs for diabetes, coronary disease and asthma. Led by Alexander Ries as the responsible physician, it accepts statutory and private insurance and communicates in German, English and Russian. It also offers weight loss injections, travel medicine, diving and driver medical certificates and home visits for immobile patients. Extended hours, video consultations and separate phone lines for prescriptions and appointments make it highly accessible for the Frickenhausen community.

novadata.com.ar NOVADATA S.A. is an Argentine IT integration group founded in 1994 in Buenos Aires, comprising Novadata, Net Service and Compañía Global de Servicios with 130 plus certified professionals. It provides IT infrastructure, business continuity, AI, pay-per-use HPE GreenLake, microinformatics and 24/7 Service Desk services to major corporations across Argentina. It holds HPE Platinum, Microsoft Gold, Cisco Silver, VMware Enterprise and Symantec Gold partner certifications, adding Huawei Enterprise Authorized Reseller status in 2026. Major clients include Bayer, Veolia, La Anónima, Petrobras, Citibank, Roche and Bimbo, many with over 10 years of partnership. The group completed a financial restructuring agreement from 2014, declared fulfilled by court in March 2026. Recent strategic moves include an AI alliance with AYI Group, Fortinet cybersecurity training and launch of Novadata GREEN IT asset disposition services.

commtank.com CommTank Inc is a US storage tank contractor founded in 1997 in Winchester, Massachusetts, specializing in installation, removal, inspection and maintenance of underground and aboveground storage tanks across New England and the Mid-Atlantic. With 50 to 100 employees and estimated revenue of 10 to 25 million dollars, it serves government facilities, hospitals, schools and industrial clients across 8 states. Its services cover the full tank lifecycle including UST and AST installation, leak testing, cathodic protection, soil remediation and emergency spill response. Led by founder Rick Connolly, it holds EPA, MA DEP, CT DEEP and NFPA certifications and runs its own field crews without subcontracting core work. It also provides Phase I and II environmental site assessments and SPCC compliance planning. The company has built a niche in high-barrier tank services requiring specialized licensing and regulatory expertise.

ined.fr INED is France's National Institute for Demographic Studies, founded in 1945 in Paris as a public scientific research institution under CNRS patronage and the world's largest demographic research center with 200 staff and 120 researchers. It holds a unique mandate as France's national population statistics authority, producing the annual Démographie de la France report and the monthly Population and Sociétés bulletin. Its 8 research departments cover mortality, fertility, migration, social stratification and global health, publishing over 300 scientific papers per year. INED maintains 20 plus demographic databases including the global Human Fertility and Human Mortality Databases with Max Planck and UC Berkeley. Led by Director Cyrille Schott, it partners with the UN, WHO and 50 plus international institutions while offering open access to all publications.

giodentalsl.com GIO Dental SL is a modern dental clinic and laboratory founded by Nigerian dentist Dr. Gift Nwachukwu Obiorah in Freetown, Sierra Leone, with an additional location in Koidu, Kono District. It is Sierra Leone's first fully integrated dental provider offering clinical treatment, a prosthetics laboratory, dental technology education and equipment repair under one brand. Services span general and cosmetic dentistry, orthodontics, oral surgery, custom prosthetics fabrication and community oral health programs. Led by founder Dr. Gio, the company trains local dental technicians and runs outreach campaigns to make premium dental care accessible across the country. Its vertical model combining treatment, manufacturing and education is unique in the Sierra Leonean healthcare market. It also provides equipment repair and supply services to other dental clinics in the region.

skcapitalpartners.com Revenue $63 Million SK Capital Partners is a New York-based private equity firm founded in 2007 as a spinoff from Apax Partners, managing approximately 10 billion dollars across 60 plus investments in specialty chemicals, pharmaceuticals and ingredients. Led by co-founder Barry Siadat, it targets control investments in companies with 100 million to 1 billion dollars in revenue and has built platforms like Advansix, Sartomer and Cura Particles through buy-and-build strategies. Its portfolio companies employ over 12,000 people and generate more than 5 billion dollars in annual revenue. Recent deals include the July 2026 acquisition of Lorama Group and the October 2026 purchase of Vesuvius Americas refractory assets. Key strengths are deep sector expertise in real-economy industrial businesses and proven IPO and trade sale exits.

cbh.com Revenue $446.7 Million CBH Group Australia's largest grain cooperative, founded in 1933 in Perth and owned by over 3,700 farmer shareholders across Western Australia. It operates the world's largest grain export network with around 200 receival sites, 20 million tons of storage capacity and four export terminals at Kwinana, Albany, Geraldton and Esperance. Each year it handles approximately 20 million tons of grain and exports 15 to 17 million tons, mainly wheat, barley and canola to Asia, the Middle East and beyond. Led by CEO Brendan White, it has invested over 2 billion dollars in infrastructure modernization including rail upgrades, solar energy and digital platforms like the CBH App. The cooperative is financially strong with a BBB credit rating and returns profits to farmers through patronage dividends. It operates its own rail fleet of 360 wagons, runs quality testing laboratories at every site and is expanding port capacity to load Panamax vessels at Kwinana and Albany.

angelescontractor.com Angeles Contractor Inc is a general contractor founded in 1998 in City of Industry, California, with 8 CSLB license categories and 63 to 95 employees delivering construction projects across Southern California. It has completed 259 public works projects worth over 197 million dollars for 47 government agencies, led by San Bernardino County with 73 contracts. Its portfolio includes the Rose Bowl renovation, UCLA dining hall, CGV Cinemas, Paakuma K-8 School and a 14.5 million dollar Big Bear Airport terminal rebuild. Led by President Young W. Kang and VP Alex Cho, it maintains over 90 percent repeat business across education, healthcare, commercial and residential sectors. It holds multiple JOC contracts with San Bernardino, San Mateo and Sourcewell worth up to 30 million dollars per year. The company is a certified Minority Business Enterprise with active expansion into Northern California through offices in San Jose and Salinas.

svedala.se Svedala kommun is a municipality in Skåne County, Sweden, part of Greater Malmö with 23,722 residents and a projected growth to 26,800 by 2032. It jumped from 63rd to 15th place in Sweden's Bäst att leva 2026 ranking, ranking number one nationwide in business climate, self-sufficiency and outbound commuting. The local economy centers on transport and warehousing driven by Malmö Airport, with Sandvik SRP as the largest private employer and a new Airport City MMX business park planned to create 1,000 jobs. The municipality runs a balanced budget of SEK 1.66 billion with a tax rate below the national average. Education performs above average with 89.8 percent gymnasium eligibility and 80.3 percent qualified teachers. It is investing 431 million kronor in infrastructure 2025 to 2027.

myfirstdental.com First Dental Care is a dental practice network in Massachusetts founded by Dr. Farshad Ghobbeh, who opened his first clinic in Medford in 2008 and expanded to Somerville in 2012 and four more locations including Arlington, Watertown, Acton and Bedford. With over 20,000 patients and 18 years of experience, it offers general and cosmetic dentistry, dental implants, Invisalign, emergency care and smile makeovers across six clinics. Its Smile Now Pay Later model with Klarna makes implants available from 58 dollars per month and whitening at 149 dollars instead of 500. The team is multilingual speaking English, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese and Persian to serve diverse Massachusetts communities. It accepts over 15 insurance plans including Aetna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, Delta Dental and MassHealth. Key strengths are 18 years of community trust, multi-location accessibility, affordable payment plans and Dr. Ghobbeh's personal commitment to quality oral health.

bi-link.com Revenue $380.2 Million  Bi-Link US precision manufacturer founded in 1961 (HQ Bloomingdale, IL), making metal stampings and injection-molded plastics with in-house tooling and assembly for automotive, medical, wireless, and consumer electronics OEMs. It owns plants in Shanghai, Nanning, Mexico (Juárez), and a new Vietnam site (2024), offering prototype-to-production under one roof. Revenue isn't reliably public — broker estimates range wildly from ~$10M to $50M, but a TaiPEX filing suggests ~$5M+/month after consolidation. The critical development: in October 2025 family owners agreed to sell the company to Taiwan-listed Donpon Precision, closed and consolidated from Jan 2026. Despite the site still claiming "family-owned", control is now Donpon's, and long-time CEO Tom Harris has exited. Certifications (ISO 9001, ISO 13485, IATF 16949) support real OEM work (e.g. Teleflex via a 3D Systems case)

fptsoftware.com FPT Software is the largest IT services company in Southeast Asia, founded in 1999 in Hanoi with 1.34 billion dollars in revenue and over 33,000 employees across 31 countries. It serves 1,100 clients including 130 Fortune Global 500 companies across automotive, banking, healthcare and energy, with Japan as its largest international market. Its AI-first strategy uses the FleziPT platform delivering 30 percent productivity gains, with AI and data services growing 60 percent in 2026. In 2025 it signed a record 256 million dollar AI transformation deal and secured 26 projects above 10 million dollars. Strategic partnerships span NVIDIA, Microsoft, SAP, AWS and OpenAI. Key strengths are unmatched scale from Vietnam, deep AI capabilities and a 152,000 strong education talent pipeline.

eichstaett.de 1,5 tb information Eichstätt is a small historic town in Upper Bavaria with 13,500 inhabitants and 1400 years of history, famous for its baroque architecture, Jura Museum with Archaeopteryx fossils and UNESCO Altmühltal Geopark. The Katholische Universität Eichstätt-Ingolstadt enrolls about 4,800 students across 4 faculties spanning theology, philosophy, languages and business in Ingolstadt. Under President Dr. Klaus Stüwe since 2023, it received 5.86 million euro in Bavarian funding for digital transformation and AI programs. It is developing an international campus in Shandong, China and launching new sustainability master's degrees. Key strengths are its Catholic identity, small class sizes and strategic location between Munich and Nuremberg.

www.regencypk.com https://www.zoominfo.com/c/regency-park-oak-knoll/235454820 Regency Park Oak Knoll specializes in providing world-class memory care and assisted living services for residents with dementia or memory loss in Pasadena, California. With over 50 years of experience, their expert staff offers personalized care, socialization, and a range of therapies tailored to each resident's needs. The facility is dedicated to ensuring a safe, secure, and homelike environment, focusing on the physical, emotional, and spiritual well-being of its residents. Recognized as a premier memory care community, Regency Park Oak Knoll is committed to treating every resident like family.

immovia-hausverwaltung.de ImmoVia Hausverwaltung GmbH is a German property management company registered in November 2025 in Bautzen, Saxony, founded by property owners who bring their own landlord experience to managing rental properties and condominium associations. Led by Managing Director Ramona Biehle with equal shareholders holding 33.3 percent each, the firm offers rental management, WEG administration, technical building management and DATEV-compatible tax data integration. Its philosophy is reliable, solution-oriented and personal management treating each property as if it were its own.

post_title: Mercantile Investment Corporation Bolivia S A
description: Mercantile & Investment Corporation Bolivia S.A. is a Bolivian broker-dealer and investment house founded in 1983 in La Paz, licensed by ASFI, the national financial regulator, with over 43 years of experience in the Bolivian capital markets. It is the investment arm of international Grupo MIC, offering securities trading, foreign exchange, financial leasing, repo operations, centralized securities custody and discretionary portfolio management. Led by Managing Director Alberto Barrón Michel, it serves institutional investors and corporate clients seeking access to Bolivia's Bolsa Boliviana de Valores. Bolivia's capital market is one of the smallest in Latin America, giving licensed players like MIC a niche with limited competition. Key strengths are full ASFI licensing, international group backing and a comprehensive financial product suite spanning brokerage, leasing and asset management. The firm positions itself as a trusted long-term wealth protector in a market dominated by trade

superscale.com SuperScale is a Slovak game growth platform founded in 2015 in Bratislava, helping over 500 mobile game studios scale their games through AI-powered performance marketing, data science and monetization optimization. With around 60 employees and 1000 plus games grown, it offers both a SaaS platform and managed growth services acting as an outsourced UA and live ops team. Its core technology includes predictive LTV and retention models, automated user acquisition campaigns and AI creative production across Facebook, Google, TikTok and Apple Search Ads. Led by CEO Ivan Trancik, the company specializes in hybrid monetization strategies combining ads, in-app purchases and subscriptions for casual, midcore and hypercasual titles.

rexvilleradiology.com Rexville Radiology is a diagnostic imaging center in Bayamón, Puerto Rico, founded by neuro-radiology specialist Dr. Ramón Pizarro Fornaris and accredited by the American College of Radiology. It offers a full range of imaging services under one roof including open MRI, 64-slice CT scanning, 3D digital mammography with tomosynthesis, ultrasound, DEXA bone density and digital X-ray. The center stands out for its open MRI design that accommodates claustrophobic patients and its advanced breast imaging with 3D tomosynthesis for early cancer detection. Led by Dr. Pizarro, a recognized neuro-radiologist, it provides personalized care with fast turnaround times and early opening hours from 6 AM six days a week.

gbl-trier.de Grundbaulabor Trier is a German geotechnical engineering firm founded in 1960 in Trier by Dr. Paul Lehmann, now run by the third generation of the Lehmann family with 23 qualified engineers. It has completed over 20,000 projects in soil investigation, foundation design, construction supervision, environmental contamination assessment and hydrogeology across Rhineland-Palatinate, Saarland and Luxembourg. The firm operates its own soil mechanics laboratory offering fast and reliable sample processing with modern testing equipment. Led by Managing Directors Eric Lehmann and Bernd Mertes, it is one of the leading geotechnical bureaus in the Trier-Saarbrücken-Luxembourg region.
