manngroup.com.au Mann Group is an Australian multi-disciplinary engineering and construction company founded in 1992 in Sydney, operating through eight subsidiaries including Mechtronic Engineering, Mann Fab, Mann Energy, Mann Enviro and Mann Solar. With 350 plus employees, it is Australia's leading provider of thermal, electrical, environmental and sanitary engineering solutions. The group covers pipe fabrication, structural steel, pressure vessels, industrial boilers, HVAC, waste-to-energy and renewable energy systems. Its headquarters and central workshop are located in Milperra, Sydney, with a financial year ending in June.

sap.com SAP Latin America and Caribbean is the regional arm of SAP SE, the world's largest enterprise software company, managing operations across 10 countries with about 6,000 employees led by President Adriana Aroulho since April 2025. Brazil is the standout market, cited in 40 straight quarters of global earnings for exceptional cloud revenue growth and now having more customers running on cloud than on-premise. The region serves over 5,000 clients in Brazil alone and holds 50 percent share among large Brazilian enterprises, with major wins including Grupo Nutresa, Honda South America, Votorantim, Chedraui and Motta Internacional. Through RISE with SAP and GROW with SAP, the company drives cloud ERP migration and Business AI adoption with its Joule assistant, targeting up to 30 percent productivity gains for clients. SAP's global cloud revenue reached 6.7 billion euro in Q3 2026 with the LatAm cloud market projected to double to 125 billion dollars by 2030.

ac-environnement.com Groupe AC Environnement is a French environmental engineering company founded in 1997 in Pontarlier, delivering integrated solutions for water treatment, wastewater, waste management and bioremediation. With 160 employees across five subsidiaries including GEG, Maraîch'Hydro and Biovéa, it has completed over 120 projects in 13 countries. Its standout project is the STEP des Voraces, France's first large-scale wastewater plant featuring demethanization serving 300,000 equivalent inhabitants. The group offers 26 specialized technical solutions spanning drinking water, industrial effluent, zero liquid discharge and circular economy applications. Led by Johan Hansma, it operates across the full project lifecycle from design and construction to long-term operations and maintenance.

tradeunionco.com tuc-dxb.com Trade Union Co. is a family-owned automotive spare parts wholesaler and retailer founded in 1960 in Beirut, Lebanon, with over 65 years of experience serving customers across the Middle East, Africa, Europe, Asia and the Americas. The group operates through its Beirut headquarters and The Trade Union International LLC in Dubai, a 5000 square meter global re-export hub established in 2007 with offices also in Germany, Russia and Nigeria. With over 150 employees and 20 plus international aftermarket brands including Bosch, Mahle, ZF and Sachs, it supplies parts for European, Japanese and American passenger and commercial vehicles. Led by CEO Walid El Bissani and Head of Strategy Tarek Jamil, the company is a member of NEXUS Automotive International, the world's largest automotive distribution community. It regularly exhibits at Automechanika Dubai and Frankfurt, showcasing its growing brand portfolio and global logistics network.

some.it SOME Srl is an Italian ERP and financial systems consulting company founded in 2001 in Milan, delivering end-to-end implementations of Epicor Kinetic, Infor SunSystems and Fluentis ERP for manufacturing, hospitality and oil and gas clients. With about 22 employees and revenue of 2.8 million euro, it has completed over 100 implementations across Europe, the Americas and North Africa. The company operates both as a system designer building ERP architectures and as a local specialist adapting global models to Italian fiscal and regulatory requirements. Led by Sales Director Franco Giannini and Partner Hussein Bahobeshi with 25 years of hospitality ERP expertise, it serves international hotel chains, oil companies like Mellitah and ENI Congo, and mid-size manufacturers.

wabag.in VA Tech WABAG is the world's leading pure-play water technology company, founded in 1924 and headquartered in Chennai, India, operating in over 25 countries with 2000 engineers and over 1500 plants delivered. Listed on NSE and BSE, it posted record FY2026 revenue of 3944 crore rupees with PAT of 371 crore and has been net cash positive for 6 straight years with a credit rating of AA minus stable. Its order book surged to an all time high of 19400 crore rupees in Q1 FY2027, over 4 times annual revenue, backed by World Bank, ADB and JICA funded projects across India, the Middle East, Africa and Southeast Asia. Key projects include Southeast Asia's largest 400 MLD desalination plant in Chennai and a 300 MLD mega desalination order in Saudi Arabia. The company holds 125 plus proprietary patents and ranks 3rd globally among private water operators and desalination suppliers per Global Water Intelligence. Led by Chairman Rajiv Mittal.

lydenburg.toyota.co.za Lydenburg Toyota is a Toyota dealership in Lydenburg (Mashishing), Mpumalanga, South Africa, part of the Toyota South Africa Motors dealer network selling new Toyota and Lexus vehicles, certified used cars, service, parts and financial services. The town is also home to Toyota SA Manufacturing, the largest Toyota plant in Africa, assembling Hilux, Fortuner and Corolla Cross with engines and components exported to over 40 countries including the United States. Toyota SA Motors holds 24.2 percent of the South African vehicle market and exported 187 billion rand in FY2023, with 8500 direct employees across its plants. The company invested 2.43 billion rand in hybrid technology and is developing a 2.2 billion dollar Mbombela megaproject including housing, schools and hospitals around the Lydenburg plant. Corolla Cross production from Lydenburg began exports to the US in April 2024.

unisa.es Unisa Shoes is a Spanish footwear company founded in 1973 in Elche, Alicante, with 52 years of history across three generations of the Pérez Parres family. It designs and produces women's, men's and accessories collections sold in 70 plus countries through around 30 own stores, 150 plus Espacio Unisa points of sale and its e-commerce platform. Revenue reached 25.3 million euro in 2024 with 145 employees, and international online sales hit a record 16 percent in 2025. Led by CEO Carlos Pérez Parres, the company launched its men's line in 2021 and an eco-friendly recycled suede collection, positioning itself as an accessible Spanish lifestyle brand. It opened a 300 square meter showroom in Madrid and a subsidiary in Italy to expand European distribution. Core strengths are family heritage, global reach across 70 countries and a diversified omnichannel sales model.

zinkanenterprises.com Zinkan Enterprises is a private US environmental services company founded in 1983 in Hunt Valley, Ohio, operating in water treatment, pond and lake management, oil and gas chemicals and waste management. With 45 to 75 employees and estimated revenue of 5 to 20 million dollars, it owns several brands including Pace Products, the creator of Freeze Free, the world's first anti-freeze pond coating dating back to the 1960s. Its Crystal Clear division manages ponds and water features for prestigious clients including Walt Disney World golf courses and the 2006 Open Championship at Royal Liverpool. Led by founder Thomas Zinkan, the company offers full-cycle solutions from chemical products to fountain equipment and contract pond maintenance. Core strengths are 42 years of experience, a unique patented anti-freeze technology and diversified revenue across four environmental service verticals.

malmsten.com Malmsten AB is a Swedish family-owned company founded in 1975 in Täby, the world's leading manufacturer of swimming pool and open water equipment including lane lines, buoys, starting blocks and safety gear. With around 30 employees and global distribution, its equipment has been used at 11 consecutive Olympic Games from Moscow 1980 to Paris 2024. Founder Robert Malmsten received the FINA Gold Pin Award in 2024 for 48 years of service to the international swimming federation's equipment committee. The company's proprietary wave calming technology reduces turbulence in competition lanes, making its Golden Series the gold standard for elite swimming events. Led by CEO David Malmsten in the second generation, it operates a subsidiary in Australia and serves 100 plus national swimming federations worldwide. Key strengths are FINA approval, Olympic heritage and a full product range from elite competition to public pool equipment.

betopiagroup.com Betopia Group Betopia Group is a Bangladeshi tech holding based in Dhaka, formally created in July 2025 by consolidating 22 business units including Bdcalling IT, Softvence, Sparktech, JVAI and Zencore, claiming 5,000 employees and 36 million dollars in annual revenue. Founded by Muhammad Monir Hossain, who went from freelancing on oDesk in 2013 to launching Bdcalling IT in 2017 with just 500,000 taka and 7 people, the group now serves clients in over 80 countries with 80 to 90 percent of business from the United States. Its units span software development, AI, cloud infrastructure via ZenexCloud, Odoo ERP implementation, renewable energy through PulseGrid and IT education. In July 2026 the group unveiled Vision 2030, planning to double its workforce and build Betopia City, an AI-powered smart tech hub in Bangladesh. The company is embroiled in a major scandal, with Fiverr suspending around 300 accounts linked to Betopia for coordinated marketplace manipulation.

acodafe.com Acodafe S.L. is a Spanish IT services company founded in 2009 in Mataró, Barcelona, providing managed IT, network installation, cybersecurity, cloud backups, data center hosting and GDPR consulting for small and medium businesses. Led by sole administrator Adrián Conde Kuller, it has just 4 employees and annual revenue between 500,000 and 1.5 million euro. The company grew sales by 22.8 percent in 2024 and climbed over 12,000 positions in Spain's national business ranking. Its services cover the full IT lifecycle for SMEs and industrial clients from system maintenance and installation to 24/7 emergency support. In 2019 it expanded into data protection consulting, a growing regulatory niche in Spain. Key strengths are 17 years of market presence, a lean and profitable operation and a diversified service portfolio tailored to small business needs.

atlasstamping.com Atlas Stamping Manufacturing Corp. is a US metal stamping company founded in 1971 in Richardson, Texas, producing precision stamped parts for automotive, aerospace, electronics, medical and industrial customers. With around 50 to 200 employees and estimated revenue of 5 to 20 million dollars, it operates a full-service plant offering progressive and transfer die stamping, deep draw, forming, welding and assembly. Its own tool and die shop designs and maintains all stamping dies in-house, giving full control over quality and lead times. Press capabilities range from 30 to 400 tons handling materials from thin foil to quarter-inch thick steel, aluminum and specialty alloys. The company has served the Dallas-Fort Worth industrial market for 54 years with ISO 9001 quality systems and PPAP compliance for OEM clients.

epmmop.quito.gob.ec EPMMOP is the Metropolitan Public Company of Mobility and Public Works of Quito, Ecuador, responsible for urban transportation infrastructure and public works across the capital district of 2.7 million people. It manages the city's integrated transport system including the new Quito Metro, launched in December 2023 as Ecuador's first subway line with 22.4 kilometers and 15 stations. The agency also operates the TelefériQo cable car, one of the highest in the world, plus trolleybus, BRT and cable car systems under the SITM integrated transit framework. It builds and maintains roads, bridges, sidewalks, drainage and one of Latin America's largest cycling networks. The company works within Quito's UNESCO World Heritage context, requiring unique engineering solutions for the historic center.

pureperfection.com Pure Perfection GmbH is a German live communication agency founded in 2008 in Wiesbaden, ranked number one in the 2026 BlachReport German Event Creativity Ranking ahead of insglück and Vok Dams. With 72 to 80 employees across offices in Wiesbaden, Berlin, Düsseldorf and Florida, it delivered 133 events in 2025, with 90 of them abroad including Shanghai, Miami and Singapore. Led by co-founders Jan Rogozinski and Kim Meisinger, the agency works through three units: Pure Live for events, Pure Space for brand spaces and architecture, and Pure Content for storytelling and PR. Major clients include Audi, ŠKODA, L'Oréal, Bentley and Nestlé, with pharma being its largest vertical at 90 events per year. Revenue peaked at 26.4 million euro in 2023 and the agency won 60 MUSE Creative Awards in 2026 alone.

belmontresorts.com Belmont Resorts is a small boutique hotel in McLeodganj, Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh, operating as Hotel Satovari Pride on the Strawberry Hills with panoramic views of the snow-capped Dhauladhar mountains. It has just 14 rooms across four categories from Deluxe to Premium Gold corner suites with private balconies, mini-fridges and sunrise-sunset views from both sides. Positioned as a value-for-money alternative next to ITC Hotels and Lemon Tree, it offers a pure vegetarian restaurant with Jain cuisine, 24/7 power backup, fast WiFi and free parking. The hotel caters to relaxation, spiritual tourism, trekking and long-term workation stays with tour packages to Khajjiar and Dalhousie.

softwareone.com SoftwareOne Turkiye is the Turkish arm of SoftwareOne Holding AG, a Swiss-listed global software and cloud solutions provider that merged with Crayon to form a 13,000 person company operating in over 70 countries. Based in Ataşehir, Istanbul and active since 2019, it employs around 40 to 60 people and works with 100 percent of Turkey's top 50 companies and 80 percent of the top 500. Services span software licensing advisory for Microsoft, IBM and Oracle, cloud migration across Azure, AWS and Google Cloud, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, AI and FinOps. In December 2024 SoftwareOne AG acquired full ownership of the Turkish entity, approved by the Turkish Competition Authority. Led by Managing Director Doğa Pekdemir and CFO Hakan Keriş, it has delivered projects for Turkish Airlines, TAV Airports, Coca-Cola and Vakıf Katılım. Key strengths are its unmatched enterprise market coverage in Turkey and full access to the global SoftwareOne and Crayon ecosystem.

farmacias911.com.ec Gettareq S.A., known as Farmacias 911, is a major Ecuadorian pharmaceutical company founded in 2013 in Guayaquil, combining retail pharmacy, wholesale distribution, OEM manufacturing and medical consulting across the whole country. The group operates six brands including Farmacias 911 retail, ACOSAR wholesale distribution, Galenic for private label manufacturing, One Laboratory for quality testing and Conseplus for consulting. It has grown from 11 to 500 employees with a 166 percent increase in headcount, working with global pharmaceutical giants like Abbott, Bayer, Bristol Myers Squibb, Takeda and Roche. Led by founder and CEO Marlon Morillo, the company hosted Ecuador's largest pharmaceutical convention in 2025 alongside APESFA. Its vertical integration from import and production to retail and lab testing is unique in the Ecuadorian market.

sanirent.com.mx Grupo Sanirent is a 100 percent Mexican company founded in 1983 in Mexico City, the national leader in portable toilet rental, mobile offices, septic services and waste management. With 178 employees and operations in all 32 Mexican states, it serves everything from private events and luxury weddings to massive construction sites and industrial operations. Its business lines include standard and VIP portable toilets, camper-style luxury stations, mobile office rentals, industrial drain cleaning with specialized vactor and guzzler trucks, and full waste collection including hazardous and bio-infectious materials. The company holds ISO 9001 certification and has won 53 government contracts with major institutions like IMSS, CFE, CAPUFE and the National Culture Secretariat. Its premium Eventos Especiales division provides luxury sanitary facilities for high-end events across the country. Key strengths are 43 years of experience, full national coverage, diversified service.

starimagesouthlake.com StarImage Dental Boutique & Oral Surgery is a premium dental practice in Southlake, Texas, opened in January 2021 as the second location of StarImage Dentistry founded by Dr. James Green in Wichita Falls over 25 years ago. Led by Dr. Green, oral surgeon Dr. Dustin Van Tassell and Dr. Susan Millner, it offers cosmetic and reconstructive dentistry, dental implants, full mouth rehabilitation, oral surgery, TMJ treatment and sleep apnea care all under one roof. The clinic is one of the most technologically advanced dental offices in the US, equipped with Planmeca ProMax 3D CBCT imaging, MLS laser therapy, VELscope cancer screening and CT-guided implant surgery. Both lead doctors hold Fellow status at the Las Vegas Institute for Advanced Dental Studies, and the practice maintains a perfect 5.0 rating across 50 plus reviews. Its dedicated TMJ and Sleep Center provides a high-margin specialization in jaw disorders and obstructive sleep apnea.

wika-beton.co.id WIKA Beton (PT Wijaya Karya Beton Tbk) is Indonesia's largest precast and prestressed concrete manufacturer, founded in 1997 and listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange since 2014 as part of state-owned Wijaya Karya group. It operates over 20 production plants across Indonesia from Java to Papua, producing more than 189 types of concrete products including bridge girders, piles, culverts and railway sleepers. Revenue is estimated at around 5.3 trillion rupiah with a market cap of 1.9 trillion, offering a 3.5 percent dividend yield and trading well below book value. The company is a primary supplier for Indonesia's massive infrastructure boom including toll roads, the Jakarta-Bandung high-speed railway and new port construction. Led as a state-owned enterprise, it benefits from priority access to government contracts and a unique nationwide plant network.

incomelec.com Incomelec is a Colombian company founded in 2006 in Bogota, the Latin American leader in pedestrian, vehicle and passenger access control including turnstiles and automated barriers. With 52 employees and operations in 14 countries, it has installed equipment in over 20 airports, 90 parking facilities and 250 buildings, handling more than 85 percent of Colombia's toll booth systems. Its flagship product is BIOMIG, an automated migration control system used at El Dorado and Medellin airports with iris scanning and passport verification. It is the exclusive regional partner of Automatic Systems from the Bollore Group and the only distributor worldwide that locally assembles TR-490 and TR-491 turnstile lines. Led by CEO Kris De Sutter Gomez, it serves Metro de Medellin, TransMilenio and BD Bacata, Colombia's tallest building.

epichealth.com.au Epic Health is an Australian medical group founded in 2001 in Melbourne, running multiple brands including Epic Medical general practice, Epic Youth Health, Epic Skin Health and Alevia Medical Weight Loss. Its fastest-growing division is Alevia, offering doctor-supervised weight loss programs using GLP-1 medications like Mounjaro and Ozempic across four clinics plus telehealth Australia-wide. The group combines traditional family medicine with niche verticals like dermatology, adolescent health and aesthetic medicine under one team-based model. Led by medical director Dr. Neeraj Mahindra, it serves patients nationally through Medicare-compatible telehealth with instant rebates and a dedicated digital app. Key strengths are 24 years of operation, a debt-free financial position and multi-brand diversification into high-demand health niches. The company is well positioned in Australia's booming medical weight loss and telehealth markets.

surexport.es Surexport is the largest independent berry producer in Europe, founded in 1994 in Huelva, Spain, growing strawberries, raspberries, blueberries and blackberries across Spain, Portugal, the Netherlands, Morocco and Kenya. Owned since 2020 by Alantra Private Equity, the group is valued at around 600 million euros with revenue approaching 400 million and over 2500 employees. Its competitive edge is exclusive berry varieties developed with US genetics partner Plant Sciences since 2007, sold under the Doñarosa, Berry Sensations and Fruhi brands. Major clients include Tesco, Lidl, Mercadona and Sainsbury's, with 80 percent of revenue from exports to Northern Europe. The company invested 200 million euros in acquisitions and secured a 250 million euro loan in 2025.

aslinsaat.com.tr ASL İnsaat is a Turkish construction company based in Istanbul, operating in civil and industrial building contracting both domestically and internationally. It provides full-cycle services including design, general contracting and project management for residential, commercial and industrial projects. The company is privately held with estimated staffing of several hundred employees scaling with active construction sites. Turkey is the world's second largest market for international construction contractors, and ASL operates within this competitive ecosystem. Key sectors are residential complexes, shopping centers, hotels, factories and infrastructure. Typical strengths of Turkish contractors like ASL are cost competitiveness, speed of delivery and experience in challenging geographies across the Middle East, Africa and Central Asia.

vietnamairlines.com Revenue $4.4 Billion Vietnam Airlines is the national flag carrier of Vietnam, founded in 1956 and listed as HVN, with hubs in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City and about 86 percent state ownership together with ANA Holdings as strategic investor. It is a SkyTeam member operating 103 aircraft including Airbus A350s and Boeing 787 Dreamliners across 113 routes to 39 international destinations in 22 countries. In 2025 it posted record results with consolidated and net profit of 290 million dollars, carrying 25.6 million passengers. In February 2026 it finalized an order for 50 Boeing 737 MAX 8 jets worth about 10 billion dollars. The group includes Pacific Airlines, VASCO, VAECO maintenance and SKYPEC fuel units. Its target is to become a five-star Skytrax airline and the number two carrier in Southeast Asia by 2030.

nwmicro.com Northwest Micro Systems, formally Northwest Micro Inc., is a private IT services and software company founded in 1998 in Atlanta, Georgia, serving small businesses with managed IT, cloud backup, email, CRM and custom .NET development. Led by founder and owner Leo Zhadanovsky, it has around 11 employees and steady revenue of roughly 5 million dollars. Its unique model offers affordable one-time products like the One 2 One email server and Speed To Success CRM for about 100 dollars with lifetime updates and support. The company positions itself as the anti-corporate alternative to Oracle and Microsoft, focused on keeping small business clients for life. Core strengths are 28 years of market presence, a loyal SMB client base and a low-overhead operation. Its tech stack centers on Microsoft 365, SQL Server and .NET with a mix of SaaS and on-premise tools.

serit.no Serit CC, formally C.C. Solution AS, is a Norwegian IT services company founded in 2007 in Bergen, providing cloud, cybersecurity, managed IT, Microsoft 365 and AI automation to small and medium businesses. It has 6 employees and annual revenue of around 17 million Norwegian kroner, and since June 2025 it is part of Serit, one of Norway's largest independent IT groups with 27 offices and over 200 specialists. The company holds Helsenett certification for healthcare clients and runs its own Norwegian data center, keeping all data inside the country. It is led by founder and CEO Christopher Andreas Namtvedt, a former NATO systems administrator, together with CTO Ole Erik Skare who has been with the firm for 17 years. Core strengths are deep Bergen market knowledge combined with the national scale of Serit group partnerships with Microsoft, Fortinet, Dell and Lenovo. A newer focus is secure AI adoption and workflow automation for business clients.

zehren.com Zehren and Associates Zehren & Associates is an architecture and design firm founded in 1983 in Avon, Colorado, specializing in resort and mountain architecture with a second office in Santa Barbara, California. Led by founder Jack Zehren, a West Point graduate, the firm has about 37 employees and revenue of roughly 5 million dollars. It offers a full package of architecture, master planning, interior design and landscape architecture, known for projects like The 10th restaurant on Vail Mountain and The Blake hotel at Taos Ski Valley, voted the best ski hotel in North America. The firm designed the Beaver Creek master plan, winner of the Snow Country Best Resort award, and has worked in over 9 countries including Argentina, Korea and Mexico. Key strengths are 43 years of niche expertise and long-term partnerships with Vail Resorts and East West Partners.

pac.se PAC Group is a Swedish power plant automation company founded in 1979 in Stockholm, delivering control systems, simulation and optimization solutions for thermal, hydro, nuclear and renewable power plants. It has completed over 600 projects on more than 100 power plants across 50 countries with a combined capacity exceeding 110 gigawatts. Its product portfolio includes PAC Control, PAC-Sim full scope simulators, PAC-Balance and the ARTOCloud optimization platform, plus engineering, commissioning and cybersecurity services. The company is independent from major DCS vendors like Siemens and Emerson, giving it flexibility to integrate any technology. Led by CEO Mikael Andersson, many engineers have been with PAC for 20 to 34 years, ensuring deep institutional expertise. New directions include hydrogen power plants, battery energy storage, hybrid plant control and digital twin solutions.

unitedrolls.com United Rolls United Rolls Inc. is a US mill roll manufacturer founded in 1898 in Canton, Ohio, producing horizontally spun cast iron and steel rolls for hot strip, cold strip, plate and roughing mills worldwide. It is a subsidiary of WHEMCO and Park Corporation, employing around 64 to 110 people and generating estimated revenue of 10 to 20 million dollars. Its plant pours, heat treats, grinds and tests rolls under one roof with a capacity of 18,000 tons per year and rolls up to 66 tons. The company is known for its patented Synergy line, including Synergy 100 high-speed steel rolls and UR2-EC niobium carbide iron rolls that extend mill campaign life. Led by President Robert Feielin since 2024, it is part of WHEMCO, the only US maker of all roll types for flat rolling, with sales offices in Berlin and Sheffield. Key strengths are 128 years of heritage and full vertical integration.

mks.dk Marie Kruses Skole is a private school in Farum, Denmark, founded in 1869 by education pioneer Marie Kruse, offering a full track from kindergarten through gymnasium STX to about 1100 students. It is the only free primary school and the only gymnasium in Furesø Kommune, employing 107 people and led by rektor Carsten Gade. The school runs 8 gymnasium study lines including Biotek, Mat-Fys, sports, business, super languages and music, plus unique programs like Kruse Elitesport and diving. Revenue in 2024 reached 109.5 million Danish kroner with a 1.4 million profit, backed by 68 percent state subsidy and a stable surplus for 5 straight years. Tuition is 2190 kroner per month with financial aid available, and it attracts over 1100 students on its waiting list. Its key strengths are 157 years of heritage, top national exam results and free admissions independent of municipal student distribution rules.

spontinimilano.com Spontini is a Milanese pizza by the slice chain founded in 1953, now run by the third generation of the Innocenti family with Massimo Innocenti as CEO and his son Andrea leading operations. The group runs about 27 stores in Milan and 15 more across 10 countries including Japan, Korea, Qatar and Saudi Arabia, mostly through franchising with partners like M.H. Alshaya. It serves around 2.4 million pizza slices a year using an unchanged 1953 recipe with 100 percent Italian ingredients like Molini Certosa flour and Rodolfi tomatoes. Revenue has grown to roughly 30 million euro with over 800 employees, driven by expansion into travel locations like Milan Central station and Malpensa airport. In 2026 the brand entered retail with a frozen pizza line called Tonda 1953 produced with SanNico Food.

pencoproducts.com Penco Products US metal manufacturer founded in 1869, now based in Greenville, North Carolina, making steel lockers, shelving, pallet racks and garment dispensers at its 375,000 square foot ISO certified plant in Hamilton. It is part of the IMC industrial group and has around 200 employees, up to 350 in summer peaks. Its lockers are an American standard in schools, gyms, hospitals and military facilities, with new smart locker lines for contactless pickup. Led by CEO Craig Atwater since 2021, it sells through a national distributor network with QuickShip warehouses across the country. Strengths are 157 years of brand trust, full US vertical production and diversification into school furniture.

conaxtechnologies.com Conax Technologies US manufacturer founded in 1952 in Buffalo, New York, producing temperature sensors like thermocouples and RTDs together with high-pressure compression seal fittings for extreme conditions. Owned by the private equity firm May River Capital, it has around 200 to 500 employees and estimated revenue of roughly 41 million dollars. Its products operate in extreme temperatures up to 2000 Fahrenheit and pressures up to 100,000 psi across aerospace, defense, semiconductor, medical and energy markets. The company runs a 101,000 square foot plant with 150 machines, holds AS9100, NADCAP and ISO certifications, and has over 45 patents with 100 million products installed worldwide. Under CEO John LeFevre since 2023 it is expanding through acquisitions such as Vulcan Electric and Sorregosa Spain plus growth in semiconductor and medical verticals.

redoaktech.com Red Oak Technologies private IT staffing and managed services company founded in 1995 and headquartered in San Jose, California, with offices in Austin and Denver. It has about 250 employees across 5 countries and estimated revenue of roughly 105 million dollars. The company provides contract tech talent, direct hire and full project delivery with offshore and nearshore teams. It specializes in cloud, DevOps, semiconductor and life sciences clients from startups to Fortune 500. Led by President Joel Leege, ex-Randstad Technology, it has completed over 1700 projects in 30 years with 92 percent client retention.

weld8.org Weld Re-8 School District public school district founded in 1914 in Fort Lupton, Colorado, serving about 2500 students across 7 schools with a 43.5 million dollar budget. The student body is 76 percent minority with over half on free lunch, and academics are weak, math proficiency 16 to 19 percent, reading 22 to 26 percent, far below state averages. The core problem is teacher pay, starting salaries 47500 dollars versus 53000 to 64500 nearby, driving 23 percent yearly turnover. Voters rejected four tax requests since 2023, and on November 3 2026 they vote Issue 5C, a 4.9 million dollar tax hike, or face 1.3 million in mid-year cuts. New superintendent Dr. Justin Ralston launched a 2026 to 2029 plan reviving agriculture and adding IT and cybersecurity tracks. Oil and gas covers over half the local tax base.

C**** Technologies c****technologies.com specializes in designing and manufacturing compression seal fittings, temperature sensors, and cable and harness assemblies for a diverse range of industries. Their products cater to applications in power generation, semiconductor, and furnace and autoclave sectors, among others. The company is committed to providing custom-designed solutions to meet specific client needs. With a focus on quality and innovation, C**** Technologies aims to address complex engineering challenges for its clients.

P**** Products p****products.com specializes in storage and material handling equipment, offering a wide range of products including lockers, shelving, pallet racks, garment dispensers, and hygiene products. Their offerings cater to various sectors such as schools, healthcare, and government agencies, with a focus on providing durable and efficient storage solutions. The company operates a modern manufacturing facility in North Carolina and utilizes QuickShip distribution centers to ensure timely delivery of products. P**** is committed to quality and innovation, serving clients with tailored solutions for their storage needs.

airq-ad.com AirQ UAE drone manufacturer founded in 2021 in Masdar City, Abu Dhabi, producing unmanned aerial systems fully in-house. It was started by Croatian entrepreneurs Dino Dedić as CEO and Igor Pongrac as CTO, who previously worked at Rimac Automobili, and has grown from 6 people to about 100 engineers. The flagship product is the Harara modular VTOL drone, carrying 6 kg of payload and flying up to 7 hours or 600 km in hybrid mode, with over 1000 test flights completed. Other products include the StingJet reusable jet target drone for air defense training and the world's first fully electric UAV launcher. The company is backed by Abu Dhabi institutions such as Tawazun Council and Masdar City Free Zone and runs real operations like medical blood sample delivery between hospitals. Its main strengths are full in-house composite production and dual defense plus commercial markets, while the main risks are its young age, ongoing aviation certification and dependence on UAE defense.

wellingtoncollege.ac.th Wellington College Bangkok is a British international school for ages 2 to 18, opened in 2018 as part of Wellington College UK, with around 1100 students on a 28 acre campus in eastern Bangkok. The curriculum runs from the English National Curriculum to IGCSE and A Levels, with the first graduating class in 2026. Fees range from about 639000 baht per year in pre nursery up to 1283500 baht in Year 12, plus a 225000 baht registration fee and a 175000 baht refundable deposit. Results are elite level with 80 percent A star or A at IGCSE and every graduate of 2026 admitted to their first choice university including Stanford, Yale and Imperial College. Admissions are selective with CAT4 testing and interviews, and strong English is required from Year 10. The school is famous for its Olympic pool, FIFA standard pitch, 600 seat theatre, wellbeing curriculum and scholarships in music, swimming, golf and academics.

giodentalspa.com Gio Dental & Med Spa  private dental and aesthetic clinic founded around 2006 in Ciudad Juárez, Mexico, targeting patients from the US border region of El Paso and Las Cruces. The practice has about 6 employees and estimated annual revenue of roughly 430000 dollars, making it a small self-owned business with no external funding. Its business model is built on cross-border dental tourism, accepting American HMO and PPO insurance and transporting patients from El Paso directly to the clinic. Core services are dental implants, orthodontics, endodontics, veneers and oral surgery, plus a med spa division with botox, fillers and physiotherapy. The clinical founder and director is Dr. Mauro D. Álvarez, an implantology specialist, working with a team of about five additional dentists. The company is positioned on price: complex dental procedures cost a fraction of US rates while offering full-service treatment and aftercare for American patients.

firstdentalhealth.com First Dental Health, Inc. dental consulting company founded in 1995 and based in Sacramento, California. It is led by Chairman and CEO Michael Zhang together with founder Dr. Rick Kershner, a periodontist who previously worked with Western Dental, Coast Dental and Pacific Dental Services. The company transforms existing dental practices of 40 to 250 chairs through leadership development, culture building and operational excellence, typically raising performance by 40 to 80 percent within 2 to 4 years. Its flagship case is Sacramento Dentistry Group, which grew from around 330000 dollars monthly revenue in 2014 to roughly 640000 dollars by 2023. It also runs a DSO consolidation model that merges 6 to 10 practices under one brand with owners keeping equity and a 3 to 7 year exit path. The team has built 14 companies that made the Inc. 5000 list, positioning it as a small but high-impact operator in US dental business consulting.

martinllp.net Martin LLP Martin LLP is a boutique business law firm founded in 1996, with offices in Stamford and New York. It focuses on middle-market companies, private equity sponsors, lenders, and business owners. Core practices: M&A and private equity, banking and finance, commercial litigation, and commercial real estate. The firm positions itself as partner-led, with small teams and senior lawyers doing hands-on work on deals from a few million to several hundred million dollars. Its people come from large national firms like Skadden, Latham & Watkins, Mayer Brown, and Schulte Roth. It publishes actively on M&A topics, notably representation and warranty insurance (RWI). It is recognized in regional rankings such as Best Law Firms 2026 for Corporate Law in Stamford.

map.ch MAP SA Swiss communications agency in Cossonay, Vaud (UID CHE-106.859.955), operating since 1968 as a business; the current legal entity was registered in 1981. It's a ~13-person full-service shop covering brand strategy, SEO/SEA, social media, and event management. Leadership: Sébastien Graap (took over 2003) and Caroline Müller (partner since 2008). Only revenue figure ever made public is ~CHF 2M for 2010; no current financials are disclosed anywhere. Core clients are French-speaking Swiss SMEs and public bodies — CarPostal, Transports publics de la région lausannoise, La Source, Yverdon Énergies, Changins. A separate training arm, map.academy, publishes rates (CHF 800–3,900 packages, CHF 1,200/day, CHF 890/month coaching); agency project work is quote-only. Portfolio runs ~30 cases with claimed results (e.g. 7% energy savings, 1,200+ event visitors)

suhaiseguranca.com.br Suhai Segurança Pessoal Brazilian personal security company founded in 1992 — one of the older, established firms in its niche. Core business: bodyguard/executive protection, family and residential security, security drivers, and corporate guarding, delivered nationwide. Teams are described as vetted, licensed professionals backed by 24/7 monitoring and in-house tactical training. The firm claims ISO 9001 and Great Place to Work certification, but doesn't publish certificates — claims are self-reported. No revenue, pricing, or verified headcount is public; everything is custom-quoted per job. Critically: since Brazil's 2024 law, security work is only legal if the firm holds a current federal police permit for that specific service and state — confirm yours before hiring. Also beware the unrelated "Suhai" auto insurer sharing the name — most complaints you'll find online are about insurance, not this company.

sbiav.com SBI Audiovisuel is a Quebec AV company founded in 1991 (HQ in Saint-Bruno-de-Montarville, ~11 staff), doing corporate event production — sound, lighting, video, webcasting — plus its signature niche: live streaming of surgical operations for medical training. It deploys its own CASTER mobile system and claims exclusive North American rights to France's Medinbox tech, which is used at hospitals like Mount Sinai NY; note SBI is an integrator, not the tech's manufacturer. Public activity runs from 2018 through 2026 (US tours, medical congresses, hiring), with no lawsuits or scam signs found. Revenue is not disclosed — third-party estimates vary ($1–5M range), all unverified. Weak spots: no independent client reviews, no published certificates, and the site blurs its own brand with Medinbox's. For Quebec/Canada corporate events or live-surgery broadcasts it's a credible pick; for critical projects, verify team size, redundancy plans, and patient-data handling in writing.

saga-u.ac.jp Saga University is a national Japanese university in Saga Prefecture, Kyushu — founded in 1949 (roots back to 1875), merged with Saga Medical School in 2003, operating as a national university corporation since 2004. Scale: ~6,600 students, ~3,300 staff, 6 faculties (including medicine with a ~600-bed hospital) across Honjo, Nabeshima, and Arita campuses. Annual revenue ¥44B ($300M), ~57% of it generated by the university hospital; state capital ¥47.3B, with a +¥1.6B surplus in FY2024. Signature strength: the Institute of Ocean Energy (IOES) — a world leader in OTEC (ocean thermal energy), pursuing the world's first 1-MW commercial plant ~2026-27 with Mitsui O.S.K. Lines. Rector since Oct 2025: Koichi Node (cardiologist); 2026 launches include Japan's first national-university cosmetic science program (30 students, 7x oversubscribed) and a joint teacher-training degree with Kumamoto University. Weak points: rankings have slid for a decade (QS Asia 801-850, THE 1501+)

netcoreunbxd.com Netcore Unbxd AI product-discovery platform for enterprise e-commerce: smart site search, 1:1 personalization, recommendations, visual intelligence ("Complete the Look"), catalog enrichment, and — its 2026 bet — a Shopping Agent (agentic commerce). Owned by India's Netcore Cloud since March 2022 (~$100M deal, 90%), run by founders Pavan Sondur and Prashant Kumar; SaaS sits on composable, API-first infra (Cloudflare, Kubernetes, multi-region), with <10ms response on 95% of queries and 35M documents processed monthly. Recognition: Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader 3 years running, highest "Current Offering" score in Forrester Wave Q3 2025, 7 G2 badges Summer 2025. Claimed customer results (self-reported): +38% AOV, +28% conversion, −60% null searches, −53% bounce. Positioning is sharply anti-native-search and anti-generic-AI, aimed at retail merchandisers with no-code workbenches and full override control. Site's main CTA is a free "personalized site experience audit."

regio-nord.com REGiO-Nord mbH (HRB 1203, Amtsgericht Neuruppin) is a municipal regional-development company in Gransee, Brandenburg, founded 2008–2009 to run the shared "Mittelzentrum" of Gransee–Zehdenick–Fürstenberg/Havel. It is 100% publicly owned (Zehdenick 1/3, Fürstenberg 1/3, Gransee 1/6, Amt Gransee 1/6), led by sole managing director Olaf Bechert with a staff of ~5 plus two tourist info offices. Its real money flows through the Kooperationsfonds — ~€8.9M in projects since 2008, with €538K spent in 2025 and €563K budgeted for 2026, of which €312K funds the company's own coordination work. Four workstreams: education (teacher recruitment, apprenticeship exchange), economy (business services, doctor recruitment, arztidylle.de), tourism (two info stations, region portals, RegioApp), and regional marketing (REGiO-Card, library network). Finances are project-transparent (open budget reports) but the GmbH's own annual accounts are only public through 2022 — request 2023–2025.

museumsiam.org Museum Siam museum in Bangkok run by NDMI under the public organization OKMD — the .org domain is real, but it's a government institute, not a private company. It occupies the former Ministry of Commerce building (1921–1922) and opened as a museum on 2 April 2008. The core exhibit Decoding Thainess (14 rooms on how Thai identity was formed) has run since 2017; there's also a free Underground Museum at MRT Sanam Chai (2020). Attendance is ~250–343K per year (different counting methods), 3.8M over 17 years; museum-level revenue isn't disclosed — finances publish only at OKMD level. Tickets: 100 THB adult, 50 students, free for kids under 15, 60+, monks, disabled visitors; open Tue–Sun 10:00–18:00. Beyond exhibits: a 4,000+ resource library, digital archives, venue rental (5–80K THB), and a nationwide museum-network support program.

skincenter.com Skin Center dermatology clinic in Fort Lauderdale, FL (6550 N Federal Hwy, Suite 320) with 40+ years of practice roots (formerly Dr. Roger Stewart's clinic, led by Dr. Barry Galitzer since the 2010s). Full spectrum: medical dermatology, Mohs surgery for skin cancer, cosmetic injectables/lasers (Botox, CoolSculpting, Ultherapy, Fraxel), an Acne Center, aesthetics, and massage. The hidden headline: since 2021 it's owned by Forefront Dermatology (125+ clinics, backed by Canadian pension fund OMERS Private Equity) — billing, records, and HR run through the network, not the local brand. Doctors rate excellent (Galitzer 4.7/5 on Healthgrades; Castle Connolly Top Doctor), but admin/office process is the weak spot — complaints cite long waits, forgotten patients, and a brusque bedside manner. Team: ~10 providers (Galitzer, Fien, Perrotto, Soro, White, Brown + PAs), plus a second office in Pompano Beach; 200+ patients/day, 10,000 sq ft.

kasetbrand.co.th Thai Ha PCL (SET: KASET) is a Thai public company founded 1993, listed since 2005, exporting jasmine rice, mung bean noodles, and snacks (brands KASET, SMART CHEF, IMPERIAL TASTE) to 80+ countries — the US is its largest market (902+ shipments, active as of Oct 2026). Core assets: a rice mill in Nakhon Pathom (100K tons/yr capacity) and a noodle factory in Nakhon Sawan; certified BRC Grade A+, US FDA, Halal, KOSHER, SMETA. The family Tangpiroonthum controls ~42% via Cheer Group Holdings, CEO Somroek Tangpiroonthum in place since 2004. But financially it's been bleeding: revenue fell from ฿611M (2020) to ฿302M (2025), six consecutive years of losses totaling ~฿330M, negative operating cash flow, debt/equity ~143%. A turnaround plan launched in 2024 — including halving par value (฿1.00→฿0.50) to wipe ~฿139M accumulated deficit — is narrowing losses (Q2 2026 −66% YoY) but the company is still unprofitable.

inovarpackaging.com Inovar Packaging Group (Irving, TX) is a PE-backed buy-and-build platform producing pressure-sensitive labels, shrink sleeves, flexible packaging, and RFID — 14 US plants, 12+ acquisitions since 2016 (latest: Kiliper Corp, Feb 2026). Owned by Kelso & Company since May 2022 (previously AEA Investors); CEO/Chairman Jeff Brezek leads, with deal advisors Milbank and Mesirow confirming real M&A scale. Revenue is private and undisclosed — realistic estimates put it at $100–250M, with ~500–750 employees (Form 5500 filings show plan participants growing 121→743 in 2020–2024). Certifications are strong: ISO 9001/14001, first US printer with GMI Platinum (both digital + flexo; serves CVS, Target, Walgreens, Home Depot), FDA 21 CFR 11 / EU Annex 11, EcoVadis Gold; won the 2024 TLMI Eugene Singer Award. Clients: food & beverage, healthcare, ag-chem, supplements, personal care — with built-in redundancy across plants for continuity.

engineersireland.ie Engineers Ireland Ireland's national professional body for engineers, founded 1835 with a Royal Charter (1877) and statutory authority under a 1969 Act to award the "Chartered Engineer" (CEng) title. HQ at 22 Clyde Road, Ballsbridge, Dublin 4; ~30,000 members (21,052 paying) across 35 regional/divisional sectors. Revenue ~€7.6M (2024) with ~€0.7M surplus and a ~€5M investment portfolio; ~49 staff, over 500 volunteers. Core functions: CEng accreditation, education program recognition (194 accredited university programs, Washington Accord member), mandatory CPD (35 hrs/yr), annual Salary Survey, and policy advocacy. President 2025–26 is John Jordan; new Director General Áine Myler started August 2026 (previously led Society of Chartered Surveyors Ireland). Membership fees run €80–€495/year by grade; the profession it represents is ~98,000 engineers contributing €12.65B to the economy, but the country faces a shortfall of ~6,000 engineers/year through 2030.

northbridge.com North Bridge Venture Partners one of Boston's most storied venture capital firms, founded in 1994 by Bill Geary, Doug Kingsley, Ed Anderson, Mike Pehl, and Richard D'Amore — ~$3.5B under management across 8 funds, ~200+ investments, 100+ exits, and 14 unicorns. Legendary portfolio: Demandware (sold to Salesforce for $2.8B), Starent Networks ($2.9B to Cisco), Proto Labs (IPO), Couchbase ($1.5B to Haveli, 2025), Quora, Salsify, Acquia ($1B to Vista), Actifio (to Google), Paydiant (to PayPal). Its growth-equity arm split off in 2018 as Guidepost Growth Equity ($1.1B+ AUM). Today the fund is in harvest mode — no new deals since 2021–2022, small remaining team, minimal website. May 2026: ransomware group DragonForce claimed to have stolen 22.9GB of internal files (unconfirmed by the firm). For startups seeking capital it's not an active option; for portfolio/LP diligence or the breach, it remains relevant.

songwooi.co.kr SONGWOOI (Song Woo Industrial Co., Ltd.,) South Korean manufacturer of automotive and industrial rubber hoses — intercooler/TCI, heater, fuel, CPF/DPF, and power steering lines — founded 1998 in Busan, HQ and plant in Yangsan since 2002. Founder-Chairman Park Su-kon localizated TCI hoses that were 100% imported from Japan, claiming 90% Korean market share; customers include Hyundai, Kia, Renault Samsung, Hyundai Heavy Industries, and Volvo CE. Certifications: IATF 16949, ISO 14001, ISO 9001; Plus Inno-Biz/Main-Biz status and national awards (Bronze Tower Medal 2015 to Park). Revenue ₩69.9B ($50M) in 2025, down from ₩104.8B peak (2013) — declining four years straight as the industry shifts to EVs — but profitability improved (5.2% operating margin, ROE 23%). Financials are unusually strong: zero debt, 80% equity ratio, ₩52.9B total assets; ~163–197 employees. Watch-outs: some databases list a different CEO (Park Eun-chul)

ptelcom.com Petroleum Telcom, Inc. (dba Telcom, Inc. / Telcom Communications) Southern California communications integrator founded in 1978 in Oxnard, CA — specializing in two-way radio for police/fire, microwave links, fiber optics, cell towers, and FCC licensing. Owned and led by Frank R. Hines (president since 1986), now a lean ~6-person shop (peak 35 in 1999), dealer for Motorola, Kenwood, and Bendix-King, with ~200 owned repeaters across CA/NV/AZ/UT. CA contractor license #620689 (B + C7) active since 1991, zero complaints, bonded and insured. Government track record is real and documented: Ventura County since 1982, Stanislaus County $1.2M, Port of LA police radio system $1.19M (2017–19), City of Oxnard up to $900K (2023–27), USGS, and 5 DoD contracts. Revenue not disclosed (est. $1–5M).

axlelogistics.com Axle Logistics non-asset freight brokerage founded in 2012 in Knoxville, Tennessee, by Drew Johnson and Jon Clay — two University of Tennessee grads who started with two people and one trucking software license. It organizes truckload, LTL, intermodal, and port drayage shipments across the US, Canada, and Mexico by matching loads with third-party carriers, focusing on Fortune 500 shippers and mid-market brands. Revenue exploded from $80M (2018) to over $1.2B gross / $159M net (2025), and headcount grew from 2 to roughly 700 — making it one of the fastest-scaling brokers in the country. It's landed on the Inc. 5000 list over a decade straight, ranked #52 among Transport Topics' top 50 logistics companies, and won Knoxville Top Workplaces seven years running. The company invested $38M in a gleaming new 84,000 sq ft HQ with state support and pays employees an average of ~$117K/year. It's a brokerage, not a carrier — so shipment quality depends on the carriers.

caspapermill.com C.A.S. Paper Mill Co., Ltd. is a Thai paper manufacturer in Singburi (est. 1990, operating since 1994), part of the Charoen Aksorn Group — Thailand's largest paper distributor, backed by Bangkok Bank and Vacharaphol. It produces 130,000 MT/yr of newsprint, printing and kraft paper plus 30,000 MT/yr of tissue (Toscotec line, 2022), from 100% recycled US/Canadian waste paper. Zero-liquid-discharge since 1994, 10 MWp floating solar; ISO 9001/14001/45001, TIS 758, FSC C125297. Exports: Vietnam, Philippines, Pakistan. Revenue est. $80–150M (~300 staff), but fell ~10% in 2025 as newsprint demand declines. Main red flag: 2018 villagers' protest over alleged coal pollution affecting 10,000+ residents, and denial of a license for the coal expansion.

stpeters.sa.edu.au St Peter's Anglican Grammar independent Anglican co-ed school in Campbelltown, NSW (est. 1983, revived parish school), teaching Pre-K to Year 6 (~428 students, ICSEA 1118 — 89th percentile nationally). It's part of the Campbelltown Anglican Schools Council (CASC) alongside Broughton Anglican College (P–12) and St Peter's Heart (special needs). Academics are solid: NAPLAN scores run ~33 points above the national average, SchoolRank rates it 69.3/100 ("Good", 129th in NSW), and it's one of only two IB PYP World Schools in the Macarthur region. Fees are modest — $9,400/yr (K–2) and $9,920/yr (Y3–6) — with generous sibling discounts up to 100%. Led by Principal Michelle McDonnell (2023–) under CEO Andrew Middleton; 39 teachers, 14.9:1 ratio, strong specialist programs (German, French, STEAM from K). The one major controversy: in July 2022 the council abruptly closed a just-launched high school (Years 7–12)

pantanalagricola.com.br Pantanal Agrícola S.A. is a Brazilian agri-input distributor (crop protection, fertilizers, seeds) founded in 2001 in São Gabriel do Oeste, Mato Grosso do Sul — 19 legal units, 15-16 stores across MS/MT/GO, ~300 employees, serving 64+ municipalities and 5 million hectares of farmland. Partners include BASF, Corteva, FMC, Sumitomo, ICL, and Brevant; the business model centers on barter (inputs repaid with grain) plus agronomic advisory. The headline event: Bunge signed an MOU in Nov 2021 to acquire a minority stake, adding grain-storage and trading muscle. It finances heavily through agri-receivables certificates (8 CRA/CDCA deals since 2019, ~R$217M+, incl. R$145M in 2025 via Ecoagro and a tokenized CDCA with Banco BV). Corporate governance is professionalizing — SA fechada since 2019, board expanded with independents in 2025-26, new CFO Flávio Sales (2025); founder-CEO Jonis Assmann still leads, with second generation (Bruno Franciosi) in management.

ak-sladek_cz Sladek & Partners Prague law firm operating as Mgr. Ivana Sládková, advokát (IČO 66252946), with 24 years of practice since 2002 — specializing in real estate transactions, divorce/family law, and attorney escrow (advokátní úschova). The firm's flagship claim: 500M CZK ($23M) held in escrow annually across 100+ segregated accounts, backed by 500M CZK insurance and 2–5 day payout guarantees. Led by Ivana Sládková (ČAK ev. č. 09496, Charles University, licensed for escrow since 2002, speaks English/German/Russian), with a tiny 3–5 person team (accountant + secretary). Listed in EPRAVO.CZ's notable law firm yearbooks (2013, 2016); pricing is quote-only (hourly/fixed/contingency), no published rates.

jjsjustice.com JJS Justice (Janet, Janet & Suggs, LLC) is a national plaintiff-side firm based in Baltimore/Pikesville, MD, founded 1996 (practice since 1978) — specializing in birth injuries/CP, medical malpractice, sexual abuse (clergy, USC/Johns Hopkins), mass torts, and whistleblower cases. Record: $3B+ in verdicts and settlements over 40 years, including the largest US sexual-abuse settlement ($852M vs. USC/Dr. Tyndall, 2021), $190M vs. Johns Hopkins, $225M NJ v. ExxonMobil, and multiple record birth-injury verdicts. Led since Sept 2025 by Andrew S. Janet after founder Howard A. Janet died at 70; core team includes Kenneth M. Suggs (ex-ATLA president) and Dr. Giles Manley (OBGYN turned lawyer). Chambers USA Band 2 (MD plaintiffs), Best Lawyers "Lawyer of the Year" 2025, Super Lawyers, Lawdragon 500, AV Preeminent, ABOTA. Contingency model (no fee unless they win), 10+ states + DC, ~17 lawyers, ~60 staff.

svmottawa.ca  ServiceMaster of Ottawa Canadian property restoration and commercial cleaning company (legal entity 1351120 Ontario Inc.), a ServiceMaster franchise since 1969 — owned since 2006 by John Cooke. HQ at 180 Wescar Lane, Ottawa (Carp/Richmond), ~140 staff, 24/7/365 emergency service across the National Capital Region. Core: water/fire/mold remediation, asbestos removal, reconstruction, odor control, janitorial — backed by IICRC techs, HCRA license B62544, Tarion, WSIB+liability, Restore 365/Xactimate. Record: 40,000+ customers served; Cooke won ServiceMaster's "Brand Ambassador of the Year" 2026, "Mid-Market Business of the Year" (Ottawa Chamber, 2008). Reputation mixed (3.8–4.3/5, 313+ reviews) — excellent on small jobs and named techs (Ryan Potestio, Jeff Jerome)

entrysystems.com Entry Systems Garage Doors & Gates 3rd-generation family business in Laguna Hills, CA (with a second design center in Tustin, opened 2024) — servicing garage doors and automated gates across South Orange County since 1972. Legal entity: Laguna Niguel Garage Door Service, Inc.; CA contractor license #916334 (class D28, active through 2028, clear record), bonded and insured. Services: garage door repair/installation (CHI, Amarr, Clopay), openers (Genie, Liftmaster, smart home), swing/slide gates (DoorKing, Elite, Eagle, solar), telephone entry systems, welding, and maintenance — same-day emergency service typical.

europassistance.co.za Europ Assistance South Africa South African emergency-assistance and insurance-administration company founded 1984 in Roodepoort, Gauteng — ~500 staff, FSCA licensed (FSP 5001), Level 1 B-BBEE, handling 1.3M calls/yr through 8,000+ providers. Key structural change: it completed a management buyout from French parent Europ Assistance (Generali Group) in late 2023 and rebranded to AZOZA in Oct 2025 — no longer part of the global Europ Assistance network (which itself merged into Generali's Redion platform in 2026). Services: roadside assistance, home emergency callouts, travel/motor claims administration, funeral cover, and white-label BPO for underwriters (Regent, Old Mutual, ABSA, Santam, Profmed, BMW, Eqstra). Led by CEO Lynette Mutsekwa (since 2023), CCO Nelson Soares. Reputation is split: B2B clients and 8,000 supplier-partners rate them well (12–20-year relationships)

otsuka.com.tw Revenue $278.3 Million Otsuka Pharmaceutical (Taiwan) Co., Ltd. Taiwanese arm of Japan's Otsuka Holdings (TSE: 4578), operating since 1974 — first as a JV, wholly owned since 1995. HQ in Taipei's Daan District with plants in Guandu and Kaohsiung, ~500–1,000 staff, capital NT$531M, president Ryoichi Fukumoto. Core business: prescription drugs (Abilify, Mucosta, nephrology/oncology lines), consumer brands (Pocari Sweat, Nature Made, CalorieMate, SOYJOY), medical devices, and a new insurance services arm. The group posted record 2025 pharma results (+22% revenue, +43% operating profit) across 84+ countries. Taiwan-specific financials aren't published (subsidiary of a listed parent), but the entity has 52 years on the market, TFDA-registered products, and a solid employer brand with active hiring since 2024.

climedi.com.br CLIMEDI  private multidisciplinary medical clinic and diagnostic center in Aracaju, Sergipe, Brazil — founded 5 Oct 1977 by Dr. João Antônio Macedo Santana (endocrinologist & nuclear medicine physician, UFS professor, SUNY Upstate NY–trained). Family-run (Santana-Macedo dynasty: João, son Gustavo, daughter Sara), with 76–121 staff, 50+ physicians across 3 units. Its unique regional edge: full nuclear medicine — PET-CT, scintigraphy, and I-131 thyroid cancer therapy with 5 CNEN-compliant isolation suites — plus 20+ specialties (endocrinology, cardiology, gastro, mastology, orthopedics, ENT, neuro) and complete diagnostics (MRI, CT, mammography, endoscopy, bone densitometry, 54+ tests). Quality credentials: PNCQ "Excelente" (highest tier), SBAC, DICQ; registered in CNES, works with SUS, private insurers, and union health plans (APCEF+). Government payments total R$ 11M+ (Portal da Transparência); private revenue undisclosed (est. R$ 20–50M/yr).

upf.br Universidade de Passo Fundo private community philanthropic university in Passo Fundo, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil — founded 1968 (Decree 62.835), run by the FUPF foundation, with 7 campuses, ~10,000 students, 486 professors (48% PhD), and 100,000+ alumni. It holds the maximum MEC institutional rating (5), ranks 6th among Brazil's best private universities and 5th in research nationally (RUF 2025), and is in the THE World 2026 ranking and top-300 globally for sustainability (GreenMetric). Flagships: Medicine (MEC concept 5, expanding from 750 to 2,000 students with R$ 60M invested), Pharmacy (MEC 5), Veterinary (Hospital Veterinário + 170-ha Cepagro), Engineering (chemical #5 nationally), and Law (70 years old). Financially healthy — R$ 60M annual surplus, independent audits published, board with civil-society oversight; ~70% of students get aid (ProUni, Bolsa Filantropia, FIES, CrediUPF). New rector for 2026–2030: Edison Alencar Casagranda (93% of votes, took office July 2026).

campbellrhea.com Campbell Rhea US manufacturer of laboratory and educational casework — legal entity Institutional Casework, Inc. (ICI) — with roots to 1951 in Paris, TN. samwumed.org zoominfo.com/c/samwumed/346685548 SAMWUMED (founded 1952, Cape Town) is a closed, self-administered medical aid scheme serving South African municipal workers — roughly 35,000 members and 73,000 covered lives.
